48static bool isUnsupportedPidAlias(PidControlTypeEnum pidtype)
49{
50 switch (pidtype)
51 {
52 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_2:
53 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_3:
54 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_2:
55 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_3:
56 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE_2:
57 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE_3:
58 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT_2:
59 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT_3:
60 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT_2:
61 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT_3:
62 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT_2:

64 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED_2:
65 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED_3:
66 return true;
67 default:
68 return false;
69 }

85bool embObjMotionControl::alloc(int nj)
86{
87 _encodersStamp.resize(nj, 0);
88
89 _parsedCfgData.resize(nj);
90
91 _last_position_move_time.resize(nj, 0);
92
93 // Reserve space for data stored locally. values are initialize to 0
94 _ref_command_positions.resize(nj, 0);
95 _ref_positions.resize(nj, 0);
96 _ref_command_speeds.resize(nj, 0);
97 _ref_speeds.resize(nj, 0);
98 _ref_accs.resize(nj, 0);
99
100 _cacheImpedance.resize(nj, {});
101
102 _parsedCfgData.rotorsLimits.resize(nj);
103 _parsedCfgData.jointsLimits.resize(nj);
104 _parsedCfgData.currentLimits.resize(nj);
105 _parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits.resize(nj);
106 _parsedCfgData.jsets.resize(nj);
107 _parsedCfgData.joint2set.resize(nj);
108 _parsedCfgData.timeouts.resize(nj);
109 _parsedCfgData.impedance_params.resize(nj);
110 _parsedCfgData.lugre_params.resize(nj);
111 _parsedCfgData.axesInfo.resize(nj);
112 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs.resize(nj);
113 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs.resize(nj);
114 _parsedCfgData.kalman_params.resize(nj);
115 _parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.resize(nj);
116 _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.resize(nj);
117 _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.resize(nj);
118 _temperatureSpikesFilter.resize(nj);
119
120 // update threshold for watchdog parametrized on the ROP transmission rate (by default is 2ms)
121 uint8_t txrate = _ethRes->getProperties().txROPratedivider;
122 for(int i = 0; i < nj; ++i)
123 {
124 _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(i).setThreshold(txrate);
125 _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(i).setThreshold(txrate);
126 }
127
128 return true;
129}

243 ImplementInteractionMode::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data(), f.angleToEncoder.data(), NULL);

245 ImplementRemoteVariables::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data());
246 ImplementAxisInfo::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data());
247 ImplementCurrentControl::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data(), f.ampsToSensor.data());
248 ImplementPWMControl::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data(), f.dutycycleToPWM.data());
249 ImplementJointFault::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data());
250 ImplementJointBrake::initialize(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data());
251 return true;

255bool embObjMotionControl::open(yarp::os::Searchable &config)
256{
257 // - first thing to do is verify if the eth manager is available. then i parse info about the eth board.
258
259 _ethManager = eth::TheEthManager::instance();
260 if(NULL == _ethManager)
261 {
262 yFatal() << "embObjMotionControl::open() fails to instantiate _ethManager";
263 return false;
264 }
265
266 eOipv4addr_t ipv4addr;
267 string boardIPstring;
268 string boardName;
269 if(false == _ethManager->verifyEthBoardInfo(config, ipv4addr, boardIPstring, boardName))
270 {
271 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::open(): object TheEthManager fails in parsing ETH propertiex from xml file";
272 return false;
273 }
274 // add specific info about this device ...
275
276 if(false == eth::parser::read(config, _bdata))
277 {
278 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "embObjMotionControl::open(): eth::parser fails to read board configuration data from xml file";
279 return false;
280 }
281
282 if(NULL == _srvParser)
283 {
284 _srvParser = new ServiceParser;
285 }
286
287
288 // - now all other things
289
290 // -- instantiate EthResource etc.
291
292 _ethRes = _ethManager->requestResource2(this, config);
293 if(NULL == _ethRes)
294 {
295 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::open() fails because could not instantiate the ethResource for " << getBoardInfo() << " ... unable to continue";
296 return false;
297 }
298 // READ CONFIGURATION
299 if(!fromConfig(config))
300 {
301 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Missing motion control parameters in config file";
302 return false;
303 }
304
305 if(!_ethRes->verifyEPprotocol(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol))
306 {
307 yError() << "embObjMotionControl: failed verifyEPprotocol. Cannot continue!";
308 cleanup();
309 return false;
310 }
311
312
313 const eOmn_serv_parameter_t* servparam = &_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice;
314 if(eomn_serv_MC_generic == _parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type)
315 {
316 servparam = NULL;
317 }
318
319 // in here ...we open ports where to print AMO data
320 _mcdiagnostics.config.mode = _parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.diagnosticsmode;
321 _mcdiagnostics.config.par16 = _parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.diagnosticsparam;
322 if(eomn_serv_diagn_mode_MC_AMOyarp == _mcdiagnostics.config.mode)
323 {
324 // prepare the ports
325 _mcdiagnostics.ports.resize(2);
326 for(size_t i=0; i<_mcdiagnostics.ports.size(); i++)
327 {
328 _mcdiagnostics.ports[i] = new BufferedPort<Bottle>;
329 _mcdiagnostics.ports[i]->open("/amo/" + _ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString + "/j" + std::to_string(i));
330 }
331 }
332
333 // Initialize the downsampler timer
334
335 _event_downsampler = new mced::mcEventDownsampler();
336 _event_downsampler->config.period = 0.01;
337 _event_downsampler->config.threshold = 5;
338 _event_downsampler->config.subcomponent = "[mc.skipped-cmd-wrong-mode]";
339 _event_downsampler->config.info = getBoardInfo();
340 _event_downsampler->start();
341
342 if(false == _ethRes->serviceVerifyActivate(eomn_serv_category_mc, servparam))
343 {
344 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::open() has an error in call of ethResources::serviceVerifyActivate() for" << getBoardInfo();
345 cleanup();
346 return false;
347 }
348
349 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl:serviceVerifyActivate OK!";
350
351
352 if(!init() )
353 {
354 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::open() has an error in call of embObjMotionControl::init() for" << getBoardInfo();
355 return false;
356 }
357 else
358 {
359 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
360 {
361 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl::init() has succesfully initted" << getBoardInfo();
362 }
363 }
364
365
366 if(false == _ethRes->serviceStart(eomn_serv_category_mc))
367 {
368 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::open() fails to start mc service for" << getBoardInfo() << ": cannot continue";
369 cleanup();
370 return false;
371 }
372 else
373 {
374 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
375 {
376 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl::open() correctly starts mc service of" << getBoardInfo();
377 }
378 }
379
380
381 _opened = true;
382
383
384 if(eomn_serv_diagn_mode_MC_AMOyarp == _mcdiagnostics.config.mode)
385 {
386 // marco.accame on 10 june 2011.
387 // in here we wait some time so that yarprobotinterface may receive amo streaming before any
388 // further module (e.g., the calibrator) sends an active control mode and starts moving the motor.
389 //
390 // how does it work?
391 //
392 // when the ETH board receives command from _ethRes->serviceStart() it enters the control loop and it
393 // waits for a non IDLE control mode etc. but it also starts streaming AMO data. It is the thread
394 // inside EthReceiver whuch process UDP pckets, so a wait inside this current thread will do the job.
395 //
396 // moreover, if _mcdiagnostics.config.par16 is > 0, then we also have a mechanism such that the AMO
397 // are streamed in a conditio of the motor not initiaized yet. in such way we can observe what is
398 // the effect of the configuration of the motor on the AMO reading.
399 //
400 // how does it work?
401 //
402 // it is the function embObjMotionControl::init() which configures the motors by sending messages
403 // with tag eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config.
404 // the ETH board, if it sees eomn_serv_diagn_mode_MC_AMOyarp and par16 > 0, it applies the config of
405 // the motor with a delay of _mcdiagnostics.config.par16 milliseconds. so, in here if we wait
406 // the same amount of time, we:
407 // - can read amo values with the motors off,
408 // - we are sure that no other module (e.g., the calibrator) will attempt to move a motor which is
409 // not yet configured.
410 // I KNOW: IT WOULD BE MUCH BETTER to wait in here until the ETH board tells us that it has configured
411 // the motor (rather then just applying a delay and hoping the ETH boards works fine). but that would
412 // require some effort which for now i prefer to postpone because "l'ottimo e' il nemico del bene"
413 // and we need a quick solution to test icub3.
414
415 SystemClock::delaySystem(0.001*_mcdiagnostics.config.par16);
416 }
417
418 return true;
419}

454void embObjMotionControl::debugUtil_printPidInfoByJointSet(void)
455{
456 auto outTypeToString = [](eOmc_ctrl_out_type_t e) -> std::string
457 {
458 switch(e)
459 {
460 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_n_a: return "n_a";
461 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_pwm: return "pwm";
462 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_cur: return "current";
463 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_cur: return "vel_cur";
464 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_pwm: return "vel_pwm";
465 default: return "unknown";
466 }
467 };
468
469 auto printPidBase = [&](const std::string& tag, int joint, const eomc::PidInfo& p)
470 {
471 yInfo() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "[PID DEBUG]" << tag.c_str()
472 << "joint" << joint
473 << "enabled" << p.enabled
474 << "group" << p.usernamePidSelected.c_str()
475 << "controlLaw" << p.controlLaw.c_str()
476 << "outType" << outTypeToString(p.out_type).c_str()
477 << "kp" << p.pid.kp
478 << "ki" << p.pid.ki
479 << "kd" << p.pid.kd
480 << "kff" << p.pid.kff
481 << "maxOut" << p.pid.max_output
482 << "maxInt" << p.pid.max_int
483 << "scale" << p.pid.scale;
484 };
485
486 auto printPidTorque = [&](int joint, const eomc::TrqPidInfo& p)
487 {
488 printPidBase("trq", joint, p);
489 yInfo() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "[PID DEBUG]"
490 << "trq-extra"
491 << "joint" << joint
492 << "ktau" << p.ktau
493 << "viscousPos" << p.viscousPos
494 << "viscousNeg" << p.viscousNeg
495 << "coulombPos" << p.coulombPos
496 << "coulombNeg" << p.coulombNeg
497 << "velThres" << p.velocityThres
498 << "filterType" << p.filterType;
499 };
500
501 yInfo() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "[PID DEBUG] begin dump by jointset";
502 for(size_t s = 0; s < _parsedCfgData.jsets.size(); s++)
503 {
504 const int numofjoints = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].getNumberofJoints();
505 yInfo() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "[PID DEBUG] set" << s << "jointsInSet" << numofjoints;
506
507 for(int k = 0; k < numofjoints; k++)
508 {
509 const int joint = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].joints[k];
510 if((joint < 0) || (joint >= _njoints))
511 {
512 yWarning() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "[PID DEBUG] invalid joint index" << joint << "in set" << s;
513 continue;
514 }
515
516 printPidBase("trj", joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[joint]);
517 printPidBase("vel", joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.vel[joint]);
518 printPidBase("mix", joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.mix[joint]);
519 printPidBase("dir_pos", joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[joint]);
520 printPidBase("dir_vel", joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[joint]);
521 printPidBase("cur", joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[joint]);
522 printPidTorque(joint, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[joint]);
523 }
524 }
525 yInfo() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "[PID DEBUG] end dump by jointset";
526}

530//TODO: shell we remove this function and the one below and put the verification of the consistency of the control law in the configuration phase, i.e. in fromConfig()?
531bool embObjMotionControl::verifyUserControlLawConsistencyInJointSet(eomc::PidInfo *pidInfo)
532{
533
534 for(size_t s=0; s<_parsedCfgData.jsets.size(); s++)
535 {
536 int numofjoints = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].getNumberofJoints();
537
538 if(numofjoints== 0 )
539 {
540 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "Jointsset " << s << "hasn't joints!!! I should be never stay here!!!";
541 return false;
542 }
543 int firstjoint = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].joints[0];//get firts joint of set s
544
545 for(int k=1; k<numofjoints; k++)
546 {
547 int otherjoint = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].joints[k];
548
549 if(pidInfo[firstjoint].usernamePidSelected != pidInfo[otherjoint].usernamePidSelected)
550 {
551 yError() << "embObjMC "<< getBoardInfo() << "Joints beloning to same set must be have same control law. Joint " << otherjoint << " differs from " << firstjoint << "Set num " << s ;
552 yError() << pidInfo[firstjoint].usernamePidSelected << "***" << pidInfo[otherjoint].usernamePidSelected;
553 return false;
554 }
555 }
556 }
557 return true;
558}

603 //if(eomc_pidoutputtype_unknown == pid_out_type)
604 //{

606 // return false;
607 //}
608 //_parsedCfgData.jsets[s].setPidOutputType(pid_out_type);
609 //_parsedCfgData.jsets[s].setCanDoTorqueControl(isTorqueControlEnabled(joint));
610
611 _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].cfg.pid_output_types.postrj_ctrl_out_type = _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[joint].out_type;

633
634bool embObjMotionControl::saveCouplingsData(void)
635{
636 eOmc_4jomo_coupling_t *jc_dest;
637
638 static eOmc_4jomo_coupling_t dummyjomocoupling = {};
639
640 switch(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type)
641 {
642 case eomn_serv_MC_foc:
643 {
644 jc_dest = &(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.foc_based.jomocoupling);
645 } break;
646
647 case eomn_serv_MC_mc4plus:
648 {
649 jc_dest = &(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.mc4plus_based.jomocoupling);
650 } break;
651
652 case eomn_serv_MC_mc4plusmais:
653 {
654 jc_dest = &(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.mc4plusmais_based.jomocoupling);
655
656 } break;
657
658 case eomn_serv_MC_mc2pluspsc:
659 {
660 jc_dest = &(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.mc2pluspsc.jomocoupling);
661
662 } break;
663
664 case eomn_serv_MC_mc4plusfaps:
665 {
666 jc_dest = &(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.mc4plusfaps.jomocoupling);
667
668 } break;
669
670 case eomn_serv_MC_advfoc:
671 {
672 jc_dest = &dummyjomocoupling;
673 } break;
674
675 case eomn_serv_MC_mc4:
676 {
677 return true;
678 } break;
679
680 case eomn_serv_MC_generic:
681 {
682 return true;
683 } break;
684
685 default:
686 {
687 return false;
688 }
689 }
690
691
692 memset(jc_dest, 0, sizeof(eOmc_4jomo_coupling_t));
693
694 //I need to initialize all elements of joint2set with "eomc_jointSetNum_none": it is used by fw to get num of setBemfParamRaw
695 //4 is teh satic dimension of joint2set. see definition of type eOmc_4jomo_coupling_t
696 for(int i=0; i<4; i++)
697 {
698 jc_dest->joint2set[i] = eomc_jointSetNum_none;
699 }
700
701 if(_parsedCfgData.joint2set.size() > 4 )
702 {
703 yError() << "embObjMC "<< getBoardInfo() << "Jointsset size is bigger than 4. I can't send jointset information to fw.";
704 return false;
705 }
706
707 for(size_t i=0; i<_parsedCfgData.joint2set.size(); i++)
708 {
709 jc_dest->joint2set[i] = _parsedCfgData.joint2set[i];
710 }
711
712 for(int i=0; i<4; i++)
713 {
714 for(int j=0; j<4; j++)
715 {
716 jc_dest->joint2motor[i][j] = eo_common_float_to_Q17_14((float)_parsedCfgData.couplingInfo.matrixJ2M[4*i+j]);
717 jc_dest->motor2joint[i][j] = eo_common_float_to_Q17_14((float)_parsedCfgData.couplingInfo.matrixM2J[4*i+j]);
718 }
719 }
720
721
722 for(int r=0; r<4; r++)
723 {
724 for(int c=0; c<6; c++)
725 {
726 jc_dest->encoder2joint[r][c] = eo_common_float_to_Q17_14((float)_parsedCfgData.couplingInfo.matrixE2J[6*r+c]);
727 }
728 }
729
730 for(size_t s=0; s< _parsedCfgData.jsets.size(); s++)
731 {
732 eOmc_jointset_configuration_t* cfg_ptr = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].getConfiguration();
733 memcpy(&(jc_dest->jsetcfg[s]), cfg_ptr, sizeof(eOmc_jointset_configuration_t));
734 }
735
736
737 if(eomn_serv_MC_advfoc == _parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type)
738 {
739 // i will copy data from jc_dest to the effective destination
740 eOmc_adv4jomo_coupling_t *ajc = &_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.advfoc.adv4jomocoupling;
741 ajc->type = eommccoupling_traditional4x4;
742 // i copy some fields as they are
743 std::memmove(&ajc->data.coupling4x4.joint2set[0], &jc_dest->joint2set[0], 4*sizeof(uint8_t));
744 std::memmove(&ajc->data.coupling4x4.jsetcfg[0], &jc_dest->jsetcfg[0], 4*sizeof(eOmc_jointset_configuration_t));
745 std::memmove(&ajc->data.coupling4x4.joint2motor, &jc_dest->joint2motor, sizeof(eOmc_4x4_matrix_t));
746 std::memmove(&ajc->data.coupling4x4.motor2joint, &jc_dest->motor2joint, sizeof(eOmc_4x4_matrix_t));
747 // and i will copy only 4x4 from one field
748 for(uint8_t r=0; r<4; r++)
749 {
750 for(uint8_t c=0; c<4; c++)
751 {
752 ajc->data.coupling4x4.encoder2joint4x4[r][c] = jc_dest->encoder2joint[r][c];
753 }
754 }
755 }
756
757 return true;
758
759}

762bool embObjMotionControl::fromConfig_Step2(yarp::os::Searchable &config)
763{
764 Bottle xtmp;
765 int i,j;
766
767 measureConvFactors measConvFactors (_njoints);
768
769 if(iNeedCouplingsInfo())
770 {
771
773 if(!_mcparser->parseCouplingInfo(config, _parsedCfgData.couplingInfo))
774 return false;
775
776
778 if(!_mcparser->parseJointsetCfgGroup(config, _parsedCfgData.jsets, _parsedCfgData.joint2set))
779 return false;
780
781 //debugUtil_printJointsetInfo();
782 }
783
784
786
787
788 {
789 if(!_mcparser->parseAxisInfo(config, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data(), _parsedCfgData.axesInfo))
790 return false;
791
793 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.useRawEncoderData)
794 {
795 for (i = 0; i < _njoints; i++)
796 {
797 measConvFactors.angleToEncoder[i] = 1;
798 }
799 }
800 else
801 {
802 if(!_mcparser->parseEncoderFactor(config, measConvFactors.angleToEncoder.data()))
803 return false;
804 }
805
806 if (!_mcparser->parsefullscalePWM(config, measConvFactors.dutycycleToPWM.data()))
807 return false;
808
809 if (!_mcparser->parseAmpsToSensor(config, measConvFactors.ampsToSensor.data()))
810 return false;
811
812 //VALE: i have to parse GeneralMecGroup after parsing jointsetcfg, because inside generalmec group there is useMotorSpeedFbk that needs jointset info.
813
814 if(!_mcparser->parseGearboxValues(config, _parsedCfgData.gearbox_M2J.data(), _parsedCfgData.gearbox_E2J.data()))
815 return false;
816
817 // useMotorSpeedFbk
818 if(eomn_serv_MC_mc4 != (eOmn_serv_type_t)_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type)
819 {
820 int* useMotorSpeedFbk = 0;
821 useMotorSpeedFbk = new int[_njoints];
822 if (!_mcparser->parseUseMotorSpeedFbkFlags(config, useMotorSpeedFbk))
823 {
824 delete[] useMotorSpeedFbk;
825 return false;
826 }
827 //Note: currently in eth protocol this parameter belongs to jointset configuration. So
828 // i need to check that every joint belong to same set has the same value
829 if (!verifyUseMotorSpeedFbkInJointSet(useMotorSpeedFbk))
830 {
831 delete[] useMotorSpeedFbk;
832 return false;
833 }
834 delete[] useMotorSpeedFbk;
835 }
836 bool deadzoneIsAvailable;
837 if(!_mcparser->parseDeadzoneValue(config, _parsedCfgData.deadzone.data(), &deadzoneIsAvailable))
838 return false;
839 if(!deadzoneIsAvailable) // if parameter is not written in configuration files then use default values
840 {
841 updateDeadZoneWithDefaultValues();
842 }
843
844 if(!_mcparser->parseKalmanFilterParams(config, _parsedCfgData.kalman_params))
845 {
846 return false;
847 }
848 }
849
850
852 {
853 bool lowLevPidisMandatory = false;
854
855 if((_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type == eomn_serv_MC_foc) || (_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type == eomn_serv_MC_advfoc))
856 {
857 lowLevPidisMandatory = true;
858 }
859
860 if(!_mcparser->parsePids(config, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers, lowLevPidisMandatory))
861 return false;
862
863 debugUtil_printPidInfoByJointSet();
864
865 //2) since some joint sets configuration info is in control and ids group, get that info and save them in jointset data struct.
866 updatedJointsetsCfgWithControlInfo();
867 }
868
869 for (i = 0; i < _njoints; i++)
870 {
871 measConvFactors.newtonsToSensor[i] = 1000000.0f; // conversion from Nm into microNm
872
873 measConvFactors.bemf2raw[i] = measConvFactors.newtonsToSensor[i] / measConvFactors.angleToEncoder[i];
874 if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[0].out_PidUnits == yarp::dev::PidOutputUnitsEnum::DUTYCYCLE_PWM_PERCENT)
875 {
876 measConvFactors.ktau2raw[i] = measConvFactors.dutycycleToPWM[i] / measConvFactors.newtonsToSensor[i];
877 }
878 else if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[0].out_PidUnits == yarp::dev::PidOutputUnitsEnum::RAW_MACHINE_UNITS)
879 {
880 measConvFactors.ktau2raw[i] = 1.0 / measConvFactors.newtonsToSensor[i];
881 }
882 else
883 {
884 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid ktau units"; return false;
885 }
886 }
887
889 // Important Note. The feedback and control units must be the same for all joints of this board.
890 _measureConverter = new ControlBoardHelper(_njoints, _parsedCfgData.axisMap.data(), measConvFactors.angleToEncoder.data(), NULL, measConvFactors.newtonsToSensor.data(), measConvFactors.ampsToSensor.data(), nullptr, measConvFactors.dutycycleToPWM.data(), measConvFactors.bemf2raw.data(), measConvFactors.ktau2raw.data());
891 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[0].out_PidUnits);
892 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[0].out_PidUnits);
893 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.mix[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.mix[0].out_PidUnits);
894 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[0].out_PidUnits);
895 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[0].out_PidUnits);
896 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.vel[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.vel[0].out_PidUnits);
897 _measureConverter->set_pid_conversion_units(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[0].out_PidUnits);
898
899 // Keep interface helpers in sync with parsed conversion factors before setting PID units.
900 initializeInterfaces(measConvFactors);
901
902 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[0].out_PidUnits);
903 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[0].out_PidUnits);
904 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.mix[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.mix[0].out_PidUnits);
905 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[0].out_PidUnits);
906 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[0].out_PidUnits);
907 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.vel[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.vel[0].out_PidUnits);
908 ImplementPidControl::setConversionUnits(PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[0].fbk_PidUnits, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[0].out_PidUnits);
909
910 //Now save in data in structures EmbObj protocol compatible
911 if(!saveCouplingsData())
912 return false;
913
914
916 if(! _mcparser->parseImpedanceGroup(config,_parsedCfgData.impedance_params)) return false;
917
918
920 _mcparser->parseLugreGroup(config,_parsedCfgData.lugre_params);
921
922
924 for(j=0; j<_njoints; j++)
925 {
926 // these values have been taken from canBusMotionControl, ask to Randazzo Marco
927 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].min_damp= 0.001;
928 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].max_damp= 9.888;
929 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].min_stiff= 0.002;
930 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].max_stiff= 9.889;
931 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].param_a= 0.011;
932 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].param_b= 0.012;
933 _parsedCfgData.impedance_limits[j].param_c= 0.013;
934 }
935 //TODO
936
937
938
940 {
941 if(!_mcparser->parseCurrentLimits(config, _parsedCfgData.currentLimits))
942 return false;
943
944 if(!_mcparser->parseTemperatureLimits(config, _parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits))
945 return false;
946
947 if(!_mcparser->parseJointsLimits(config, _parsedCfgData.jointsLimits))
948 return false;
949
950 if(!_mcparser->parseRotorsLimits(config, _parsedCfgData.rotorsLimits))
951 return false;
952 }
953
955 eOmn_serv_type_t servtype = static_cast<eOmn_serv_type_t>(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type);
956
957 if((eomn_serv_MC_foc == servtype) || (eomn_serv_MC_advfoc == servtype))
958 {
959 std::string groupName = {};
960
961 if(eomn_serv_MC_foc == servtype)
962 {
963 // in here the name of the group depends on the configured board
964 eObrd_type_t brd = static_cast<eObrd_type_t>(_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.data.mc.foc_based.type);
965 groupName = (eobrd_foc == brd) ? "2FOC" : "AMCBLDC";
966 }
967 else if(eomn_serv_MC_advfoc == servtype)
968 {
969 // but in here we may have multiple boards, so ... it is better to use a generic name
970 // ADVFOC with multiple columns, one for each motor
971 groupName = "ADVFOC";
972 }
973
974 if(!_mcparser->parseFocGroup(config, _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info, groupName, _parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector))
975 return false;
976
977 for (j = 0; j < _njoints; j++)
978 {
979 //TODO: add a function in defaults to check the consistency of the configuration of the temperature sensor and limits. For now i just put this check here.
980 if (((_parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(j)->getType() != motor_temperature_sensor_none )) && ((_parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits[j].hardware == 0) || (_parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits[j].warning == 0)))
981 {
982 yError() << "In" << getBoardInfo() << "joint" << j << ": inconsistent configuration, please update it. If Temperature limits are not set then TemperatureSensorType must be NONE or not set and/or HasTempSensor must be zero. Aborting...";
983 return false;
984 }
985
986 if (_parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(j)->getType() == motor_temperature_sensor_none)
987 {
988 yInfo() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << "joint " << j << " has motor not provided with any available type of temperature sensor. If needed update the configurations file accordingly";
989 }
990 }
991 }
992 else
993 {
994 for (j = 0; j < _njoints; j++)
995 {
996 _parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(j) = std::make_unique<eomc::TemperatureSensorNONE>();
997 }
998 }
999
1000
1001
1003 if(! _mcparser->parseTimeoutsGroup(config, _parsedCfgData.timeouts))
1004 return false;
1005
1006 /*****************************************
1007 * IMPORTANT: temporary workaround
1008 * we need to be sure that the configured timeout aren't less of 300 ms
1009 * (default values), otherwise the amcfoc doesn't work because there is some lag in AMC
1010 * *********************************************/
1011 if(this->_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type == eomn_serv_MC_advfoc)
1012 {
1013 // Get default timeout from the defaults structure
1014 defaults::DefaultsFactory& factory = defaults::DefaultsFactory::getInstance();
1015 const auto& defaults = factory.getDefaults();
1016 const auto& timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc = defaults.timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc;
1017 for(int i=0; i<_njoints; i++)
1018 {
1019 _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].velocity_ref = (_parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].velocity_ref < timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.velocity_ref) ? timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.velocity_ref : _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].velocity_ref;
1020 _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].current_ref = (_parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].current_ref < timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.current_ref) ? timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.current_ref : _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].current_ref;
1021 _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].pwm_ref = (_parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].pwm_ref < timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.pwm_ref) ? timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.pwm_ref : _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].pwm_ref;
1022 _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].torque_ref = (_parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].torque_ref < timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.torque_ref) ? timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.torque_ref : _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].torque_ref;
1023 _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].torque_fbk = (_parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].torque_fbk < timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.torque_fbk) ? timeoutsDefaults_amcFoc.torque_fbk : _parsedCfgData.timeouts[i].torque_fbk;
1024 }
1025 }
1026
1027
1028 _mcparser->printOptionalParametersTable();
1029 return true;
1030}
1031
1032
1033
1034bool embObjMotionControl::verifyUseMotorSpeedFbkInJointSet(int useMotorSpeedFbk [])
1035{
1036 for(size_t s=0; s< _parsedCfgData.jsets.size(); s++)
1037 {
1038 int numofjointsinset = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].getNumberofJoints();
1039 if(numofjointsinset == 0 )
1040 {
1041 yError() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << "Jointsset " << s << "hasn't joints!!! Error in configuration!!!";
1042 return false;
1043 }
1044
1045 int firstjointofset = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].joints[0];
1046 for(int j=1; j<numofjointsinset; j++)
1047 {
1048 int joint = _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].joints[j];
1049 if(useMotorSpeedFbk[firstjointofset] != useMotorSpeedFbk[joint])
1050 {
1051 yError() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << ". Param useMotorSpeedFbk should have same value for joints belong same set. See joint " << firstjointofset << " and " << joint;
1052 return false;
1053 }
1054 }
1055
1056 _parsedCfgData.jsets[s].setUseSpeedFeedbackFromMotors(useMotorSpeedFbk[firstjointofset]);
1057 }
1058
1059 return true;
1060
1061}
1062
1063bool embObjMotionControl::verifyTorquePidshasSameUnitTypes(yarp::dev::PidFeedbackUnitsEnum &fbk_pidunits, yarp::dev::PidOutputUnitsEnum& out_pidunits)
1064{
1065 fbk_pidunits = yarp::dev::PidFeedbackUnitsEnum::RAW_MACHINE_UNITS;
1066 out_pidunits = yarp::dev::PidOutputUnitsEnum::RAW_MACHINE_UNITS;
1067 //get first joint with enabled torque
1068 int firstjoint = -1;
1069 for(int i=0; i<_njoints; i++)
1070 {
1071 if(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[i].enabled)
1072 {
1073 firstjoint = i;
1074 break;
1075 }
1076 }
1077
1078 // if no joint has torque enabled return true
1079 if(firstjoint==-1) return true;
1080
1081
1082 for(int i=firstjoint+1; i<_njoints; i++)
1083 {
1084 if(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[i].enabled)
1085 {
1086 if(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[firstjoint].fbk_PidUnits != _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[i].fbk_PidUnits ||
1087 _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[firstjoint].out_PidUnits != _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[i].out_PidUnits)
1088 {
1089 yError() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << "all joints with torque enabled should have same controlunits type. Joint " << firstjoint << " differs from joint " << i;
1090 return false;
1091 }
1092 }
1093 }
1094
1095 fbk_pidunits = _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[firstjoint].fbk_PidUnits;
1096 out_pidunits = _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[firstjoint].out_PidUnits;
1097 return true;
1098}

1100void embObjMotionControl::updateDeadZoneWithDefaultValues(void)
1101{
1102 // Get the default values structure from singleton
1103 defaults::DefaultsFactory& factory = defaults::DefaultsFactory::getInstance();
1104 const auto& defaults = factory.getDefaults();
1105
1106
1107 for(int i=0; i<_njoints; i++)
1108 {
1109 switch(_parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].type)
1110 {
1111 case eomc_enc_aea:
1112 _parsedCfgData.deadzone[i] = defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAEA;
1113 _mcparser->registerOptionalParameter("deadzone_AEA", std::to_string(defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAEA), true);
1114 break;
1115 case eomc_enc_aea3:
1116 _parsedCfgData.deadzone[i] = defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAEA3;
1117 _mcparser->registerOptionalParameter("deadzone_AEA3", std::to_string(defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAEA3), true);
1118 break;
1119 case eomc_enc_aksim2:
1120 _parsedCfgData.deadzone[i] = defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAKSIM2;
1121 _mcparser->registerOptionalParameter("deadzone_AKSIM2", std::to_string(defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAKSIM2), true);
1122 break;
1123 case eomc_enc_amo:
1124 _parsedCfgData.deadzone[i] = defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAMO;
1125 _mcparser->registerOptionalParameter("deadzone_AMO", std::to_string(defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.jointWithAMO), true);
1126 break;
1127 case eomc_enc_roie:
1128 case eomc_enc_absanalog:
1129 case eomc_enc_mais:
1130 case eomc_enc_qenc:
1131 case eomc_enc_hallmotor:
1132 case eomc_enc_spichainof2:
1133 case eomc_enc_spichainof3:
1134 case eomc_enc_mrie:
1135 default:
1136 _parsedCfgData.deadzone[i] = defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.otherEncoder;
1137 _mcparser->registerOptionalParameter("deadzone_other", std::to_string(defaults.controlParametersDefaults.deadzone.otherEncoder), true);
1138 }
1139 }
1140}

1143
1144// use this one for ... service configuration
1145bool embObjMotionControl::fromConfig_readServiceCfg(yarp::os::Searchable &config)
1146{
1147
1148 if(false == _srvParser->parseService(config, _parsedCfgData.serviceConfig))
1149 {
1150 yError() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << "cannot parse service" ;
1151 return false;
1152 }
1153
1154 if(eomn_serv_MC_generic == _parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type)
1155 {
1156 yError() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << "it is no longer possible use eomn_serv_MC_generic, because firmware cannot configure itself!" ;
1157 return false;
1158 }
1159
1160 //now _srvParser read encoders' resolutions also.
1161 //so here I save in embObMotioncontrol memory encoders's resolution
1162 servMC_encoder_t * jointEncoder_ptr = NULL;
1163 servMC_encoder_t * motorEncoder_ptr = NULL;
1164 for(int i=0; i<_njoints; i++)
1165 {
1166 jointEncoder_ptr = _srvParser->getEncoderAtJoint(i);
1167 motorEncoder_ptr = _srvParser->getEncoderAtMotor(i);
1168
1169 if(NULL == jointEncoder_ptr)
1170 {
1171 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].resolution = 1;
1172 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].type = eomc_enc_none;
1173 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].tolerance = 0;
1174 }
1175 else
1176 {
1177 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].resolution = jointEncoder_ptr->resolution;
1178 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].type = (eOmc_encoder_t)jointEncoder_ptr->desc.type; //Here I'm sure that type belong to eOmc_encoder_t enum.It is filled by eomc_string2encoder function
1179 _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[i].tolerance = jointEncoder_ptr->tolerance;
1180 }
1181
1182
1183 if(NULL == motorEncoder_ptr)
1184 {
1185 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[i].resolution = 1;
1186 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[i].type = eomc_enc_none;
1187 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[i].tolerance = 0;
1188 }
1189 else
1190 {
1191 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[i].resolution = motorEncoder_ptr->resolution;
1192 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[i].type = (eOmc_encoder_t)motorEncoder_ptr->desc.type; //Here I'm sure that type belong to eOmc_encoder_t enum.It is filled by eomc_string2encoder function
1193 _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[i].tolerance = motorEncoder_ptr->tolerance;
1194 }
1195
1196
1197 }
1198
1199
1200 return true;
1201}
1202
1203
1204
1205bool embObjMotionControl::fromConfig(yarp::os::Searchable &config)
1206{
1207
1208 _njoints = fromConfig_NumOfJoints(config);
1209
1210 if(0 == _njoints)
1211 {
1212 yError() << "embObjMC"<< getBoardInfo() << "fromConfig(): detected _njoints = " << _njoints;
1213 return false;
1214 }
1215
1216 // we have number of joints inside _njoints. we allocate all required buffers
1217 if(!alloc(_njoints))
1218 {
1219 yError() << "embObjMC"<< getBoardInfo() << "fromConfig(): alloc() failed for _njoints = " << _njoints;
1220 return false;
1221 }
1222
1223
1224 _mcparser = new eomc::Parser(_njoints, string(_ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString));
1225
1227 int currentMCversion =0;
1228 if(!_mcparser->parseMotioncontrolVersion(config, currentMCversion))
1229 return false;
1230
1231 if (currentMCversion != PARSER_MOTION_CONTROL_VERSION)
1232 {
1233 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "------ ATTENTION!!!! Wrong value of <MotioncontrolVersion> parameter !!!! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------";
1234 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "------ This means that the configuration files of this device are not compatible with my parser, so I cannot start. ";
1235 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "------ I need version " << PARSER_MOTION_CONTROL_VERSION << ", but in configuration files have version " << currentMCversion << ".";
1236 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "------ Please update configuration files in robots-configuration repository. (see https://icub-tech-iit.github.io/documentation/icub_robot_configuration/icub_robot_configuration_index/ for more information). ";
1237 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "------ If the problem persists contact icub-support@iit.it DO NOT DO IT BY YOURSELF.";
1238 yError() << "embObjMC" << getBoardInfo() << "----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------";
1239 return false;
1240 }
1241
1242 //print verbose info
1243 if(_mcparser->isVerboseEnabled(config))
1244 yTrace() << config.toString().c_str();
1245
1246
1247
1248 // first step of configuration
1249 if(false == fromConfig_readServiceCfg(config))
1250 {
1251 return false;
1252 }
1253
1254 if(!_mcparser->parseBehaviourFalgs(config, _parsedCfgData.behFlags.useRawEncoderData, _parsedCfgData.behFlags.pwmIsLimited ))//in general info group
1255 {
1256 return false;
1257 }
1258
1259 if (!_mcparser->parseMaintenanceModeGroup(config, _parsedCfgData.maintenanceModeCfg.enableSkipRecalibration))// in general maintenance group
1260 {
1261 return false;
1262 }
1263
1264 // second step of configuration
1265 if(false == fromConfig_Step2(config))
1266 {
1267 return false;
1268 }
1269
1270 // third step of configuration
1271
1272
1273 return true;
1274}
1275
1276
1277bool embObjMotionControl::init()
1278{
1279 eOprotID32_t protid = 0;
1280
1282 //SEND DISABLE TO ALL JOINTS
1284
1285 for(int logico=0; logico< _njoints; logico++)
1286 {
1287 int fisico = _parsedCfgData.axisMap[logico];
1288 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, fisico, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_cmmnds_controlmode);
1289 eOenum08_t controlMode = eomc_controlmode_cmd_idle;
1290
1291 if(false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &controlMode))
1292 {
1293 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::init() had an error while setting eomc_controlmode_cmd_idle in "<< getBoardInfo();
1294 // return(false); i dont return false. because even if a failure, that is not a severe error.
1295 // MOREOVER: to verify we must read the status of the joint and NOT the command ... THINK OF IT
1296 }
1297 }
1298
1299 SystemClock::delaySystem(0.010);
1300
1301
1303 // configure the regular rops
1305
1306 vector<eOprotID32_t> id32v(0);
1307 for(int n=0; n<_njoints; n++)
1308 {
1309 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, n, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
1310 id32v.push_back(protid);
1311 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, n, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_addinfo_multienc);
1312 id32v.push_back(protid);
1313 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_motor, n, eoprot_tag_mc_motor_status);
1314 id32v.push_back(protid);
1315 }
1316
1317 if(eomn_serv_diagn_mode_MC_AMOyarp == _mcdiagnostics.config.mode)
1318 {
1319 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, 0, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_debug);
1320 id32v.push_back(protid);
1321 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, 1, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_debug);
1322 id32v.push_back(protid);
1323 }
1324
1325
1326 if(false == _ethRes->serviceSetRegulars(eomn_serv_category_mc, id32v))
1327 {
1328 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::init() fails to add its variables to regulars in "<< getBoardInfo() << ": cannot proceed any further";
1329 return false;
1330 }
1331 else
1332 {
1333 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
1334 {
1335 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl::init() added" << id32v.size() << "regular rops to "<< getBoardInfo();
1336 char nvinfo[128];
1337 for(unsigned int r=0; r<id32v.size(); r++)
1338 {
1339 uint32_t id32 = id32v.at(r);
1340 eoprot_ID2information(id32, nvinfo, sizeof(nvinfo));
1341 yDebug() << "\t it added regular rop for" << nvinfo;
1342 }
1343 }
1344 }
1345
1346 SystemClock::delaySystem(0.005);
1347
1348
1350 // sending configuration to the JOINTS //
1352 for(int logico=0; logico< _njoints; logico++)
1353 {
1354 int fisico = _parsedCfgData.axisMap[logico];
1355 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, fisico, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config);
1356
1357 eOmc_joint_config_t jconfig = {0};
1358
1359 yarp::dev::Pid tmp;
1360 tmp = _measureConverter->convert_pid_to_machine(yarp::dev::PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION,_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[logico].pid, fisico);
1361 copyPid_iCub2eo(&tmp, &jconfig.pidtrajectory);
1362 tmp = _measureConverter->convert_pid_to_machine(yarp::dev::PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[logico].pid, fisico);
1363 copyPid_iCub2eo(&tmp, &jconfig.piddirect);
1364 tmp = _measureConverter->convert_pid_to_machine(yarp::dev::PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].pid, fisico);
1365 copyPid_iCub2eo(&tmp, &jconfig.pidtorque);
1366 //Note: The mixed control and velocity control use the position pid. The velocity direct and current PID are sent in motor configuration.
1367
1368 //stiffness and damping read in xml file are in Nm/deg and Nm/(Deg/sec), so we need to convert before send to fw.
1369 jconfig.impedance.damping = (eOmeas_damping_t) _measureConverter->impN2S(_parsedCfgData.impedance_params[logico].damping, fisico);
1370 jconfig.impedance.stiffness = (eOmeas_stiffness_t) _measureConverter->impN2S(_parsedCfgData.impedance_params[logico].stiffness, fisico);
1371 jconfig.impedance.offset = 0;
1372
1373 _cacheImpedance[logico].stiffness = jconfig.impedance.stiffness;
1374 _cacheImpedance[logico].damping = jconfig.impedance.damping;
1375 _cacheImpedance[logico].offset = jconfig.impedance.offset;
1376
1377 jconfig.userlimits.max = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.jointsLimits[logico].posMax, fisico));
1378 jconfig.userlimits.min = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.jointsLimits[logico].posMin, fisico));
1379
1380 jconfig.hardwarelimits.max = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.jointsLimits[logico].posHwMax, fisico));
1381 jconfig.hardwarelimits.min = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.jointsLimits[logico].posHwMin, fisico));
1382
1383
1384 jconfig.maxvelocityofjoint = S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.jointsLimits[logico].velMax, fisico)); //icubdeg/s
1385 jconfig.velocitysetpointtimeout = (eOmeas_time_t) U_16(_parsedCfgData.timeouts[logico].velocity_ref);
1386 jconfig.currentsetpointtimeout = (eOmeas_time_t) U_16(_parsedCfgData.timeouts[logico].current_ref);
1387 jconfig.openloopsetpointtimeout = (eOmeas_time_t) U_16(_parsedCfgData.timeouts[logico].pwm_ref);
1388 jconfig.torquesetpointtimeout = (eOmeas_time_t) U_16(_parsedCfgData.timeouts[logico].torque_ref);
1389 jconfig.torquefeedbacktimeout = (eOmeas_time_t) U_16(_parsedCfgData.timeouts[logico].torque_fbk);
1390
1391 jconfig.jntEncoderResolution = _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[logico].resolution;
1392 jconfig.jntEncoderType = _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[logico].type;
1393 jconfig.jntEncTolerance = _parsedCfgData.jointEncs[logico].tolerance;
1394
1395 jconfig.motor_params.bemf_scale = 0;
1396 jconfig.motor_params.ktau_value = _measureConverter->ktau_user2raw(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].ktau, fisico);
1397 jconfig.motor_params.ktau_scale = 0;
1398 jconfig.motor_params.friction.viscous_pos_val = _measureConverter->viscousPos_user2raw(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].viscousPos, fisico);
1399 jconfig.motor_params.friction.viscous_neg_val = _measureConverter->viscousNeg_user2raw(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].viscousNeg, fisico);
1400 jconfig.motor_params.friction.coulomb_pos_val = _measureConverter->coulombPos_user2raw(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].coulombPos, fisico);
1401 jconfig.motor_params.friction.coulomb_neg_val = _measureConverter->coulombNeg_user2raw(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].coulombNeg, fisico);
1402 jconfig.motor_params.friction.velocityThres_val = _measureConverter->velocityThres_user2raw(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].velocityThres, fisico);
1403
1404 jconfig.gearbox_E2J = _parsedCfgData.gearbox_E2J[logico];
1405
1406 jconfig.deadzone = _measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.deadzone[logico], fisico);
1407
1408 jconfig.tcfiltertype=_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[logico].filterType;
1409
1410 jconfig.kalman_params.enabled = _parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].enabled;
1411 for(int i=0; i<_parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].x0.size(); i++) jconfig.kalman_params.x0[i] = _parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].x0.at(i);
1412 for(int i=0; i<_parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].Q.size(); i++) jconfig.kalman_params.Q[i] = _parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].Q.at(i);
1413 jconfig.kalman_params.R = _parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].R;
1414 jconfig.kalman_params.P0 = _parsedCfgData.kalman_params[logico].P0;
1415
1416 if(false == _ethRes->setcheckRemoteValue(protid, &jconfig, 10, 0.010, 0.050))
1417 {
1418 yError() << "FATAL: embObjMotionControl::init() had an error while calling setcheckRemoteValue() for joint config fisico #" << fisico << "in "<< getBoardInfo();
1419 return false;
1420 }
1421 else
1422 {
1423 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
1424 {
1425 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl::init() correctly configured joint config fisico #" << fisico << "in "<< getBoardInfo();
1426 }
1427 }
1428 }
1429
1430
1432 // sending configuration to the MOTORS //
1434
1435
1436 for(int logico=0; logico<_njoints; logico++)
1437 {
1438 int fisico = _parsedCfgData.axisMap[logico];
1439
1440 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_motor, fisico, eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config);
1441 eOmc_motor_config_t motor_cfg = {0};
1442 motor_cfg.maxvelocityofmotor = 0;//_maxMotorVelocity[logico]; //unused yet!
1443 motor_cfg.currentLimits.nominalCurrent = _parsedCfgData.currentLimits[logico].nominalCurrent;
1444 motor_cfg.currentLimits.overloadCurrent = _parsedCfgData.currentLimits[logico].overloadCurrent;
1445 motor_cfg.currentLimits.peakCurrent = _parsedCfgData.currentLimits[logico].peakCurrent;
1446 motor_cfg.gearbox_M2J = _parsedCfgData.gearbox_M2J[logico];
1447 motor_cfg.rotorEncoderResolution = _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[logico].resolution;
1448 motor_cfg.rotEncTolerance = _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[logico].tolerance;
1449 motor_cfg.hasHallSensor = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].hasHallSensor;
1450 motor_cfg.hasRotorEncoder = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].hasRotorEncoder;
1451 motor_cfg.hasTempSensor = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].hasTempSensor;
1452 motor_cfg.hasRotorEncoderIndex = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].hasRotorEncoderIndex;
1453 motor_cfg.hasSpeedEncoder = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].hasSpeedEncoder;
1454 motor_cfg.verbose = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].verbose;
1455 motor_cfg.motorPoles = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].motorPoles;
1456 motor_cfg.rotorIndexOffset = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].rotorIndexOffset;
1457 motor_cfg.Kbemf = _parsedCfgData.foc_based_info[logico].kbemf;
1458 motor_cfg.rotorEncoderType = _parsedCfgData.motorEncs[logico].type;
1459 motor_cfg.pwmLimit =_parsedCfgData.rotorsLimits[logico].pwmMax;
1460 motor_cfg.temperatureLimit = (eOmeas_temperature_t) S_16(_parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(logico)->convertTempCelsiusToRaw(_parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits.at(logico).hardware)); //passing raw value not in degree
1461 motor_cfg.limitsofrotor.max = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.rotorsLimits[logico].posMax, fisico ));
1462 motor_cfg.limitsofrotor.min = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(_parsedCfgData.rotorsLimits[logico].posMin, fisico ));
1463
1464 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Km = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Km;
1465 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Kw = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Kw;
1466 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.S0 = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].S0;
1467 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.S1 = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].S1;
1468 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Vth = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Vth;
1469 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Fc_pos = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Fc_pos;
1470 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Fc_neg = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Fc_neg;
1471 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Fs_pos = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Fs_pos;
1472 motor_cfg.LuGre_params.Fs_neg = _parsedCfgData.lugre_params[logico].Fs_neg;
1473
1474 yarp::dev::Pid tmp;
1475
1476 //current pid
1477 tmp = _measureConverter->convert_pid_to_machine(yarp::dev::PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[logico].pid, fisico);
1478 copyPid_iCub2eo(&tmp, &motor_cfg.pidcurrent);
1479 //TODO: ceck if current is a optional parameter. if not here i need to check if it is anabled before convert and copy. if it is optional, then I need to set also the enable flag in motor_cfg.pidcurrent
1480
1481 //velocity pid
1482 memset(&motor_cfg.pidvelcur, 0, sizeof(eOmc_PID_t));
1483 memset(&motor_cfg.pidvelpwm, 0, sizeof(eOmc_PID_t));
1484
1485 if(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[logico].enabled)
1486 {
1487 tmp = _measureConverter->convert_pid_to_machine(yarp::dev::PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT, _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[logico].pid, fisico);
1488
1489
1490 if(eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_pwm == _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[logico].out_type)
1491 {
1492 copyPid_iCub2eo(&tmp, &motor_cfg.pidvelpwm);
1493 }
1494 else if (eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_cur == _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[logico].out_type)
1495 {
1496 copyPid_iCub2eo(&tmp, &motor_cfg.pidvelcur);
1497 }
1498 else
1499 {
1500
1501 yError() << "embObjMC " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << logico << " velocity direct pid has unsupported output type " << _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[logico].out_type;
1502 return false;
1503 }
1504 }
1505
1506
1507 if (false == _ethRes->setcheckRemoteValue(protid, &motor_cfg, 10, 0.010, 0.050))
1508 {
1509 yError() << "FATAL: embObjMotionControl::init() had an error while calling setcheckRemoteValue() for motor config fisico #" << fisico << "in "<< getBoardInfo();
1510 return false;
1511 }
1512 else
1513 {
1514 if (_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
1515 {
1516 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl::init() correctly configured motor config fisico #" << fisico << "in "<< getBoardInfo();
1517 }
1518 }
1519 }
1520
1522 // sending configuration to the CONTROLLER //
1524
1525 protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_controller, 0, eoprot_tag_mc_controller_config);
1526
1527 eOmc_controller_config_t controller_cfg = {0};
1528 memset(&controller_cfg, 0, sizeof(eOmc_controller_config_t));
1529 controller_cfg.durationofctrlloop = (uint32_t)_bdata.settings.txconfig.cycletime;
1530 controller_cfg.enableskiprecalibration = _parsedCfgData.maintenanceModeCfg.enableSkipRecalibration;
1531
1532 if(false == _ethRes->setcheckRemoteValue(protid, &controller_cfg, 10, 0.010, 0.050))
1533 {
1534 yError() << "FATAL: embObjMotionControl::init() had an error while calling setcheckRemoteValue() for the controller " << "in "<< getBoardInfo();
1535 return false;
1536 }
1537 else
1538 {
1539 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
1540 {
1541 yDebug() << "embObjMotionControl::init() correctly configured controller config " << "in "<< getBoardInfo();
1542 }
1543 }
1544
1546 // intialize the map of the rawValuesVectors //
1548 const char* tag = eoprot_TAG2string(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_addinfo_multienc);
1549
1550 _rawValuesMetadataMap.insert({{tag, rawValuesKeyMetadata({}, {}, _njoints * eOmc_joint_multienc_maxnum)}});
1551 for (auto &[k, v] : _rawValuesMetadataMap)
1552 {
1553 std::string auxstring = "";
1554
1555 for (int i = 0; i < _njoints; i++)
1556 {
1557 getEntityName(i, auxstring);
1558 if (k == tag)
1559 {
1560 v.axesNames.push_back(auxstring);
1561 v.rawValueNames.insert(v.rawValueNames.end(),
1562 {auxstring+"_primary_encoder_raw_value",
1563 auxstring+"_secondary_encoder_raw_value",
1564 auxstring+"_primary_encoder_diagnostic"}
1565 );
1566 }
1567 auxstring.clear();
1568 }
1569 }
1570 if(_parsedCfgData.behFlags.verbosewhenok)
1571 yDebug() << "_rawValuesMetadataMap initialized for " << getBoardInfo();
1572
1573 return true;
1574}

1581
1582 ImplementControlMode::uninitialize();
1583 ImplementEncodersTimed::uninitialize();
1584 ImplementMotorEncoders::uninitialize();
1585 ImplementPositionControl::uninitialize();
1586 ImplementVelocityControl::uninitialize();
1587 ImplementPidControl::uninitialize();
1588 ImplementControlCalibration::uninitialize();
1589 ImplementAmplifierControl::uninitialize();
1590 ImplementImpedanceControl::uninitialize();
1591 ImplementControlLimits::uninitialize();
1592 ImplementTorqueControl::uninitialize();
1593 ImplementPositionDirect::uninitialize();
1594 ImplementInteractionMode::uninitialize();
1595 ImplementRemoteVariables::uninitialize();
1596 ImplementAxisInfo::uninitialize();
1597 ImplementCurrentControl::uninitialize();
1598 ImplementPWMControl::uninitialize();
1599 ImplementJointFault::uninitialize();
1600 ImplementJointBrake::uninitialize();
1601
1602 if (_measureConverter) {delete _measureConverter; _measureConverter=0;}
1603
1604
1605 if(eomn_serv_diagn_mode_MC_AMOyarp == _mcdiagnostics.config.mode)
1606 {
1607 // close the ports
1608 for(size_t i=0; i<_mcdiagnostics.ports.size(); i++)
1609 {
1610 _mcdiagnostics.ports[i]->close();
1611 delete _mcdiagnostics.ports[i];
1612 }
1613 _mcdiagnostics.ports.clear();
1614
1615 _mcdiagnostics.config.mode = eomn_serv_diagn_mode_NONE;
1616 _mcdiagnostics.config.par16 = 0;
1617 }
1618
1619 delete _event_downsampler;
1620 // in cleanup, at date of 23feb2016 there is a call to _ethManager->releaseResource() which ...
1621 // send to config all the boards and stops tx and rx treads.
1622 // thus, in here we cannot call serviceStop(mc) because there will be tx/rx activity only for the first call of ::close().
1623 // i termporarily put serviceStop(eomn_serv_category_all) inside releaseResource()
1624 // todo: later on: clear regulars of mc, stop(mc), inside releaseresource() DO NOT stop tx/rx activity and DO NOT stop all services
1625 // _ethRes->serviceStop(eomn_serv_category_mc);
1626 // #warning TODO: clear the regulars imposed by motion-control.
1627
1628 cleanup();
1629
1630 return true;
1631}

1650bool embObjMotionControl::update(eOprotID32_t id32, double timestamp, void *rxdata)
1651{
1652 // use this function to update the values cached in the class using data received by the remote boards via the network callbacks
1653 // in embObjMotionControl it is updated only the timestamp of the encoders, thuus i dont used rxdata
1654 size_t joint = eoprot_ID2index(id32);
1655 eOprotEntity_t ent = eoprot_ID2entity(id32);
1656 eOprotTag_t tag = eoprot_ID2tag(id32);
1657
1658 // rxdata = rxdata;
1659
1660 // marco.accame: pay attention using rxdata. the rxdata depends on the id32.
1661 // now the function update() is called with rxdata of different types.
1662 // if the tag is eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status, then rxdata is of type eOmc_joint_status_t*
1663 // if the tag is eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_basic, then rxdata is of type eOmc_joint_status_basic_t*
1664
1665
1666 // for the case of id32 which contains an encoder value .... we refresh the timestamp of that encoder
1667
1668 if(true == initialised())
1669 { // do it only if we already have opened the device
1670 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lck(_mutex);
1671 _encodersStamp[joint] = timestamp;
1672 }
1673
1674
1675 if(eomn_serv_diagn_mode_MC_AMOyarp == _mcdiagnostics.config.mode)
1676 {
1677 char str[128] = "boh";
1678
1679 eoprot_ID2information(id32, str, sizeof(str));
1680
1681 if((eoprot_entity_mc_joint == ent) && (eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_debug == tag) && (joint < _mcdiagnostics.ports.size()))
1682 {
1683
1684 eOprotID32_t id32sc = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, joint, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
1685 eOmc_joint_status_core_t jcore = {};
1686
1687 _ethRes->getLocalValue(id32sc, &jcore);
1688
1689 int32_t *debug32 = reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(rxdata);
1690 // write into relevant port
1691
1692 Bottle& output = _mcdiagnostics.ports[joint]->prepare();
1693 output.clear();
1694 //output.addString("[yt, amo, reg, pos]"); // but we must get the joint and the motor as well
1695 output.addString("[yt, amo, reg, pos]");
1696 output.addFloat64(timestamp);
1697 output.addInt32(debug32[0]);
1698 output.addInt32(debug32[1]);
1699 output.addInt32(jcore.measures.meas_position);
1700 _mcdiagnostics.ports[joint]->write();
1701 }
1702 }
1703
1704 if((eoprot_entity_mc_motor == ent) && (eoprot_tag_mc_motor_status == tag))
1705 {
1706 if(false == initialised())
1707 return true;
1708
1709 uint8_t motor = eoprot_ID2index(id32);
1710 if((_parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(motor)->getType() == motor_temperature_sensor_none))
1711 return true;
1712
1713 eOmc_motor_status_t *mc_motor_status = reinterpret_cast<eOmc_motor_status_t*>(rxdata);
1714
1715 if((double)mc_motor_status->basic.mot_temperature < 0 ) //I get a invalid value
1716 {
1717 if(! _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).isStarted())
1718 {
1719 yWarning() << getBoardInfo() << "At time" << (yarp::os::Time::now() - _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).getAbsoluteTime()) << "In motor" << motor << "cannot read Temperature from I2C. There might be cabling problems, TDB cable might be broken or sensor unreachable";
1720 _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).start();
1721 }
1722 else
1723 {
1724 _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).increment();
1725 if( _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).isExpired())
1726 {
1727 yWarning()<< getBoardInfo() << "Motor" << motor << "failed to read" << _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).getCount() << "temperature readings for" << yarp::os::Time::now() - _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).getStartTime() << "seconds";
1728 _temperatureSensorErrorWatchdog.at(motor).start();
1729 }
1730 }
1731 return true;
1732 }
1733
1734 //if I'm here I have a valid value
1735 double delta_tmp = 0;
1736 double tmp = _parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(motor)->convertRawToTempCelsius((double)mc_motor_status->basic.mot_temperature);
1737
1738 // check if this is a spike or not
1739 // evaluate difference between current and previous temperature
1740 if(!_temperatureSpikesFilter.at(motor).isStarted()) //Pre-set of the filter buffer is ready
1741 {
1742 _temperatureSpikesFilter.at(motor).start(tmp);
1743 return true;
1744 }
1745
1746 // when i'm here the filter is ready.
1747 delta_tmp = std::abs(tmp - _temperatureSpikesFilter.at(motor).getPrevTemperature());
1748
1749 //1. check if I have a good value (not a spike)
1750 if(delta_tmp > _temperatureSpikesFilter.at(motor).getTemperatureThreshold())
1751 {
1752 //it is a spike
1753 return true;
1754 }
1755 // this is a not spike --> can update prev temperature
1756 _temperatureSpikesFilter.at(motor).updatePrevTemperature(tmp);
1757
1758 //2. tmp is good and check the limits
1759 if(tmp > _parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits[motor].warning)
1760 {
1761 if(! _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(motor).isStarted())
1762 {
1763 yWarning() << getBoardInfo() << "Motor" << motor << "The temperature (" << tmp << "[ ℃ ] ) exceeds the warning limit (" << _parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits[motor].warning << "[ ℃ ] ). Processes not stopped but it is strongly recommended decreasing motor usage or reducing currents and PWMs to not risk motor damaging";
1764 _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(motor).start();
1765 }
1766 else
1767 {
1768 if(_temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(motor).isExpired())
1769 {
1770 yWarning() << getBoardInfo() << "Motor" << motor << "The temperature (" << tmp << "[ ℃ ] ) exceeds the warning limit (" << _parsedCfgData.temperatureLimits[motor].warning << "[ ℃ ] ) again!. Processes not stopped but it is strongly recommended decreasing motor usage or reducing currents and PWMs to not risk motor damaging";
1771 _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(motor).start();
1772 }
1773 _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(motor).increment();
1774 }
1775 }
1776 else
1777 {
1778 _temperatureExceededLimitWatchdog.at(motor).clear();
1779 }
1780 }
1781 return true;
1782}

1862ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setPidRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, int j, const Pid &pid)
1863{
1864 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
1865 {
1866 return ReturnValue_ok;
1867 }
1868
1869 eOprotTag_t tag;
1870 eOprot_entity_t ent = eoprot_entity_mc_joint; //by default I set the entity to joint, but for current pid it will be set to motor. I need to set the entity because in fw the pid parameters for joint and motor are stored in different structures and with different tags, thus I need to specify the correct entity and tag when I want to send the pid parameters to fw.
1871
1872 switch (pidtype)
1873 {
1874 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION:
1875 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
1876 break;
1877 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY:
1878 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
1879 break;
1880 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE:
1881 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtorque;
1882 break;
1883 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT:
1884 ent = eoprot_entity_mc_motor;
1885 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config_pidcurrent;
1886 break;
1887 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT:
1888 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_piddirect;
1889 break;
1890 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT:
1891 // IMPORTANT NOTE: We need to manage the velocity direct pid in a different way because in fw the velocity direct pid
1892 // can be configured to output either pwm or current, thus we need to check the output type before
1893 // send the pid parameters to fw, and set the correct tag and entity.
1894 return helper_setVelDirPidRaw(j, pid);
1895 break;
1896 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED:
1897 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
1898 break;
1899 default:
1900 const auto pidtypeVocab = static_cast<yarp::conf::vocab32_t>(pidtype);
1901 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid pidtype:"<< yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(pidtypeVocab) << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
1902 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
1903 }
1904
1905 eOprotID32_t protoId = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, ent, j, tag);
1906 eOmc_PID_t outPid;
1907 Pid hwPid = pid;
1908
1909 copyPid_iCub2eo(&hwPid, &outPid);
1910
1911 if(false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protoId, &outPid))
1912 {
1913 yError() << "while setting position PIDs for " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << j;
1914 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
1915 }
1916
1917 return ReturnValue_ok;
1918}
1919
1920ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, int axis, Pid *pid)
1921{
1922 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
1923 {
1924 *pid = Pid();
1925 return ReturnValue_ok;
1926 }
1927
1928 eOprotTag_t tag;
1929 eOprot_entity_t ent = eoprot_entity_mc_joint; //by default I set the entity to joint, but for current pid it will be set to motor. I need to set the entity because in fw the pid parameters for joint and motor are stored in different structures and with different tags, thus I need to specify the correct entity and tag when I want to send the pid parameters to fw.
1930
1931 switch (pidtype)
1932 {
1933 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION:
1934 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
1935 break;
1936 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY:
1937 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
1938 break;
1939 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE:
1940 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtorque;
1941 break;
1942 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT:
1943 ent = eoprot_entity_mc_motor;
1944 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config_pidcurrent;
1945 break;
1946 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT:
1947 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_piddirect;
1948 break;
1949 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT:
1950 {
1951 return helper_getVelDirPidRaw(axis, pid);
1952 };
1953 break;
1954 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED:
1955 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
1956 break;
1957 default:
1958 const auto pidtypeVocab = static_cast<yarp::conf::vocab32_t>(pidtype);
1959 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid pidtype:"<< yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(pidtypeVocab) << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
1960 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
1961 }
1962
1963
1964
1965 eOprotID32_t protoId = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, ent, axis, tag);
1966 uint16_t size;
1967 eOmc_PID_t eoPID = {0};
1968#ifdef NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_BENCHMARK
1969 double start = yarp::os::Time::now();
1970#endif
1971
1972 bool ret = askRemoteValue(protoId, &eoPID, size);
1973
1974#ifdef NETWORK_PERFORMANCE_BENCHMARK
1975 double end = yarp::os::Time::now();
1976 _responseTimingVerifier.tick(end-start, start);
1977#endif
1978
1979 if(!ret)
1980 {
1981 yError() << getBoardInfo() << __YFUNCTION__ << "failed for joint " << axis ;
1982 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
1983 }
1984
1985 copyPid_eo2iCub(&eoPID, pid);
1986
1987 return ReturnValue_ok;
1988}

2050ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidErrorRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, int j, double *err)
2051{
2052 *err = 0;
2053 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
2054 {
2055 return ReturnValue_ok;
2056 }
2057
2058 uint16_t size = 0;
2059 eOprotID32_t id32 = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
2060 eOmc_joint_status_core_t jcore = {0};
2061 if(!_ethRes->getLocalValue(id32, &jcore))
2062 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2063
2064 switch(pidtype)
2065 {
2066 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION:
2067 {
2068 if((eomc_controlmode_torque == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) ||
2069 (eomc_controlmode_openloop == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) ||
2070 (eomc_controlmode_current == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus))
2071 return ReturnValue_ok;
2072 else
2073 *err = (double) jcore.ofpid.generic.error1;
2074 }
2075 break;
2076
2077 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT:
2078 {
2079 *err=0; //not yet implemented
2080 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2081 }
2082 break;
2083
2084 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE:
2085 {
2086 if ((eOmc_interactionmode_compliant == jcore.modes.interactionmodestatus) &&
2087 (eomc_controlmode_position == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus))
2088 {
2089 *err = (double) jcore.ofpid.complpos.errtrq;
2090 }
2091
2092 if(eomc_controlmode_torque == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus)
2093 {
2094 *err = (double) jcore.ofpid.torque.errtrq;
2095 }
2096 }
2097 break;
2098 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY:
2099 {
2100 *err = 0; //not yet implemented
2101 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2102 }
2103 break;
2104 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT:
2105 {
2106 *err = 0; //not yet implemented
2107 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2108 }
2109 break;
2110
2111 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT:
2112 {
2113 *err=0; //not yet implemented
2114 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2115 }
2116 break;
2117
2118 default:
2119 {
2120 const auto pidtypeVocab = static_cast<yarp::conf::vocab32_t>(pidtype);
2121 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid pidtype:"<< yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(pidtypeVocab) << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
2122 }
2123 break;
2124 }
2125 return ReturnValue_ok;
2126}

2144ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidsRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, Pid *pids)

2147 {
2148 std::fill_n(pids, _njoints, Pid());

2151
2152 eOprotTag_t tag;
2153 eOprot_entity_t ent = eoprot_entity_mc_joint; //by default I set the entity to joint, but for current pid it will be set to motor. I need to set the entity because in fw the pid parameters for joint and motor are stored in different structures and with different tags, thus I need to specify the correct entity and tag when I want to send the pid parameters to fw.
2154
2155 switch (pidtype)
2156 {
2157 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION:
2158 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
2159 break;
2160 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY:
2161 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
2162 break;
2163 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE:
2164 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtorque;
2165 break;
2166 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT:
2167 ent = eoprot_entity_mc_motor;
2168 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config_pidcurrent;
2169 break;
2170 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT:
2171 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_piddirect;
2172 break;
2173 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT:
2174 {
2175 return helper_getVelDirPidsRaw(pids);
2176 };
2177 break;
2178 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_MIXED:
2179 tag = eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_pidtrajectory;
2180 break;
2181 default:
2182 const auto pidtypeVocab = static_cast<yarp::conf::vocab32_t>(pidtype);
2183 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid pidtype:"<< yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(pidtypeVocab) << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
2184 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2185 }
2186
2187 std::vector<eOmc_PID_t> eoPIDList(_njoints);
2188 bool ret = askRemoteValues(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, ent, tag, eoPIDList);
2189 if(!ret)
2190 {
2191 yError() << getBoardInfo() << __YFUNCTION__ << "failed " ;
2192 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2193 }
2194
2195 for(int j=0; j<_njoints; j++)
2196 copyPid_eo2iCub(&eoPIDList[j], &pids[j]);
2197
2198 return ReturnValue_ok;
2199}

2201ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidReferenceRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, int j, double *ref)
2202{
2203 *ref = 0;
2204 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
2205 {
2206 return ReturnValue_ok;
2207 }
2208
2209 eOprotID32_t id32 = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
2210 eOmc_joint_status_core_t jcore = {0};
2211 if(!_ethRes->getLocalValue(id32, &jcore))
2212 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2213
2214 switch (pidtype)
2215 {
2216 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION:
2217 {
2218 if((eomc_controlmode_torque == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) ||
2219 (eomc_controlmode_openloop == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) ||
2220 (eomc_controlmode_current == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus))
2221 { *ref = 0; yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid getPidReferenceRaw() request for current control mode"; return ReturnValue_ok; }
2222 *ref = (double) jcore.ofpid.generic.reference1;
2223 }
2224 break;
2225 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT:
2226 {
2227 *ref=0;
2228 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2229 }
2230 break;
2231 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE:
2232 {
2233 *ref = 0;
2234 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2235 }
2236 break;
2237 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT:
2238 {
2239 *ref=0;
2240 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2241 }
2242 break;
2243 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY:
2244 {
2245 *ref = 0;
2246 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2247 }
2248 break;
2249 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT:
2250 {
2251 *ref=0;
2252 YARP_METHOD_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED();
2253 }
2254 break;
2255 default:
2256 {
2257 *ref=0;
2258 const auto pidtypeVocab = static_cast<yarp::conf::vocab32_t>(pidtype);
2259 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid pidtype:"<< yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(pidtypeVocab) << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
2260 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2261 }
2262 break;
2263 }
2264 return ReturnValue_ok;
2265}
2266
2267ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidReferencesRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, double *refs)
2268{
2269 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
2270 {
2271 std::fill_n(refs, _njoints, 0.0);
2272 return ReturnValue_ok;
2273 }
2274
2275 ReturnValue ret = ReturnValue_ok;
2276
2277 // just one joint at time, wait answer before getting to the next.
2278 // This is because otherwise too many msg will be placed into can queue
2279 for(int j=0; j< _njoints; j++)
2280 {
2281 ret &= getPidReferenceRaw(pidtype, j, &refs[j]);
2282 }
2283 return ret;
2284}

2349// Velocity control interface raw //
2351
2352ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::velocityMoveRaw(int j, double sp)
2353{
2354 yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum mode{};
2355 getControlModeRaw(j, mode);
2356 if( (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY) &&
2357 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_MIXED) &&
2358 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IMPEDANCE_VEL) &&
2359 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IDLE))
2360 {
2361 if(_event_downsampler->canprint())
2362 {
2363 yError() << "velocityMoveRaw: skipping command because " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << j << " is not in VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY mode";
2364 }
2365 return ReturnValue_ok;
2366 }
2367
2368 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_cmmnds_setpoint);
2369
2370 _ref_command_speeds[j] = sp ; // save internally the new value of speed.
2371
2372 eOmc_setpoint_t setpoint;
2373 setpoint.type = eomc_setpoint_velocity;
2374 setpoint.to.velocity.value = (eOmeas_velocity_t) S_32(_ref_command_speeds[j]);
2375 setpoint.to.velocity.withacceleration = (eOmeas_acceleration_t) S_32(_ref_accs[j]);
2376
2377
2378 if(false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &setpoint))
2379 {
2380 yError()<< getBoardInfo() << "while setting velocity mode";
2381 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2382 }
2383 return ReturnValue_ok;
2384}
2385
2386ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::velocityMoveRaw(const double *sp)
2387{
2388 ReturnValue ret = ReturnValue_ok;
2389
2390 for(int j=0; j<_njoints; j++)
2391 {
2392 ret &= velocityMoveRaw(j, sp[j]);
2393 }
2394
2395 return ret;
2396}
