2400// Calibration control interface //
2402
2403ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setCalibrationParametersRaw(int j, const CalibrationParameters& params)
2404{
2405 yTrace() << "setCalibrationParametersRaw for " << getBoardInfo() << "joint" << j;
2406
2407 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_cmmnds_calibration);
2408 eOmc_calibrator_t calib;
2409 memset(&calib, 0x00, sizeof(calib));
2410 calib.type = params.type;
2411
2412 switch (calib.type)
2413 {
2414 // muove -> amp+pid, poi calib
2415 case eomc_calibration_type0_hard_stops:
2416 calib.params.type0.pwmlimit = (int16_t)S_16(params.param1);
2417 calib.params.type0.velocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t)S_32(params.param2);
2418 calib.params.type0.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2419 break;
2420
2421 // fermo
2422 case eomc_calibration_type1_abs_sens_analog:
2423 calib.params.type1.position = (int16_t)S_16(params.param1);
2424 calib.params.type1.velocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t)S_32(params.param2);
2425 calib.params.type1.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2426 break;
2427
2428 // muove
2429 case eomc_calibration_type2_hard_stops_diff:
2430 calib.params.type2.pwmlimit = (int16_t)S_16(params.param1);
2431 calib.params.type2.velocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t)S_32(params.param2);
2432 calib.params.type2.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2433 break;
2434
2435 // muove
2436 case eomc_calibration_type3_abs_sens_digital:
2437 calib.params.type3.position = (int16_t)S_16(params.param1);
2438 calib.params.type3.velocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t)S_32(params.param2);
2439 calib.params.type3.offset = (int32_t)S_32(params.param3);
2440 calib.params.type3.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2441 break;
2442
2443 // muove
2444 case eomc_calibration_type4_abs_and_incremental:
2445 calib.params.type4.position = (int16_t)S_16(params.param1);
2446 calib.params.type4.velocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t)S_32(params.param2);
2447 calib.params.type4.maxencoder = (int32_t)S_32(params.param3);
2448 calib.params.type4.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2449 break;
2450
2451 // muove
2452 case eomc_calibration_type5_hard_stops:
2453 calib.params.type5.pwmlimit = (int32_t) S_32(params.param1);
2454 calib.params.type5.final_pos = (int32_t) S_32(params.param2);
2455 calib.params.type5.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2456 break;
2457
2458 // muove
2459 case eomc_calibration_type6_mais:
2460 calib.params.type6.position = (int32_t)S_32(params.param1);
2461 calib.params.type6.velocity = (int32_t)S_32(params.param2);
2462 calib.params.type6.current = (int32_t)S_32(params.param3);
2463 calib.params.type6.vmin = (int32_t)S_32(params.param4);
2464 calib.params.type6.vmax = (int32_t)S_32(params.param5);
2465 calib.params.type6.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2466 break;
2467
2468 // muove
2469 case eomc_calibration_type7_hall_sensor:
2470 calib.params.type7.position = (int32_t)S_32(params.param1);
2471 calib.params.type7.velocity = (int32_t)S_32(params.param2);
2472 //param3 is not used
2473 calib.params.type7.vmin = (int32_t)S_32(params.param4);
2474 calib.params.type7.vmax = (int32_t)S_32(params.param5);
2475 calib.params.type7.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2476 break;
2477
2478 //muove
2479 case eomc_calibration_type8_tripod_internal_hard_stop:
2480 calib.params.type8.pwmlimit = (int32_t) S_32(params.param1);
2481 calib.params.type8.max_delta = (int32_t) S_32(params.param2);
2482 calib.params.type8.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(params.paramZero /* * _angleToEncoder[j] */);
2483 break;
2484
2485 case eomc_calibration_type9_tripod_external_hard_stop:
2486 calib.params.type9.pwmlimit = (int32_t) S_32(params.param1);
2487 calib.params.type9.max_delta = (int32_t) S_32(params.param2);
2488 calib.params.type9.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(params.paramZero /* * _angleToEncoder[j] */);
2489 break;
2490
2491 case eomc_calibration_type10_abs_hard_stop:
2492 calib.params.type10.pwmlimit = (int32_t) S_32(params.param1);
2493 calib.params.type10.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2494 break;
2495
2496 case eomc_calibration_type11_cer_hands:
2497 calib.params.type11.offset0 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param1);
2498 calib.params.type11.offset1 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param2);
2499 calib.params.type11.offset2 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param3);
2500 calib.params.type11.cable_range = (int32_t)S_32(params.param4);
2501 calib.params.type11.pwm = (int32_t)S_32(params.param5);
2502 //calib.params.type11.calibrationZero = 32767;//(int32_t)S_32(params.paramZero * _angleToEncoder[j]);
2503 break;
2504
2505 case eomc_calibration_type12_absolute_sensor:
2506 calib.params.type12.rawValueAtZeroPos = (int32_t)S_32(params.param1);
2507 calib.params.type12.calibrationDelta = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2508 break;
2509
2510 case eomc_calibration_type13_cer_hands_2:
2511 calib.params.type13.rawValueAtZeroPos0 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param1);
2512 calib.params.type13.rawValueAtZeroPos1 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param2);
2513 calib.params.type13.rawValueAtZeroPos2 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param3);
2514 calib.params.type13.rawValueAtZeroPos3 = (int32_t)S_32(params.param4);
2515 break;
2516
2517 case eomc_calibration_type14_qenc_hard_stop_and_fap:
2518 calib.params.type14.pwmlimit = (int32_t)S_32(params.param1);
2519 calib.params.type14.final_pos = (int32_t)S_32(params.param2);
2520 calib.params.type14.invertdirection = (uint8_t)U_32(params.param3);
2521 calib.params.type14.rotation = (int32_t)S_32(params.param4);
2522
2523 if (calib.params.type14.invertdirection != 0 && calib.params.type14.invertdirection != 1)
2524 {
2525 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Error in param3 of calibartion type 14 for joint " << j << "Admitted values are: 0=FALSE and 1=TRUE";
2526 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2527 }
2528
2529
2530 if(!checkCalib14RotationParam(calib.params.type14.rotation))
2531 {
2532 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Error in param4 of calibartion type 14 for joint " << j << "Admitted values are: 0, 32768, 16384, -16384 [0, 180, 90, -90] in iCubDegree";
2533 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2534 }
2535 calib.params.type14.offset = (int32_t)S_32(params.param5);
2536 calib.params.type14.calibrationZero = (int32_t)S_32(_measureConverter->posA2E(params.paramZero, j));
2537
2538 break;
2539
2540 default:
2541 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "joint" << j << "Calibration type unknown!! (embObjMotionControl)\n";
2542 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2543 break;
2544 }
2545
2546 if (false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &calib))
2547 {
2548 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "joint" << j << "while setting remote calibration parameters";
2549 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2550 }
2551
2552
2553 return ReturnValue_ok;
2554}
2555
2556bool embObjMotionControl::checkCalib14RotationParam(int32_t calib_param4)
2557{
2558 eOmc_calib14_ROT_t urotation = eomc_int2calib14_ROT(calib_param4);
2559
2560 if (urotation == eOmc_calib14_ROT_zero ||
2561 urotation == eOmc_calib14_ROT_plus180 ||
2562 urotation == eOmc_calib14_ROT_plus090 ||
2563 urotation == eOmc_calib14_ROT_minus090)
2564 {
2565 return ReturnValue_ok;
2566 }
2567
2568 return false;
2569}

2602 calib.params.type3.position = (int16_t) S_16(p1);
2603 calib.params.type3.velocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t) S_32(p2);

2635ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::calibrationDoneRaw(int axis)
2636{
2637 eOmc_joint_status_core_t jcore = {0};
2638 eOprotID32_t id32 = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, axis, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
2639 if(!_ethRes->getLocalValue(id32, &jcore))
2640 {
2641 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Failure of getLocalValue() for axis" << axis << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
2642 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
2643 }
2644
2645 eOmc_controlmode_t type = (eOmc_controlmode_t) jcore.modes.controlmodestatus;
2646 ReturnValue result = ReturnValue_error_generic;
2647 switch(type)
2648 {
2649 case eomc_controlmode_idle:
2650 return ((_parsedCfgData.maintenanceModeCfg.enableSkipRecalibration) ? ReturnValue_ok : ReturnValue_error_generic);
2651 case eomc_controlmode_calib:
2652 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2653 case eomc_controlmode_hwFault:
2654 case eomc_controlmode_unknownError:
2655 case eomc_controlmode_notConfigured:
2656 case eomc_controlmode_configured:
2657 {
2658 yError() << getBoardInfo()<< "Unable to complete calibration: joint" << axis << " is in " << controlModeType2String(type) << " status in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
2659 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2660 } ;
2661
2662 default: // if the control mode is no longer a calibration type, it means calibration ended
2663 return ReturnValue_ok;
2664 }
2665
2666}
2667
2669// Position control interface //
2671
2672ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::positionMoveRaw(int j, double ref)
2673{
2674 defaults::DefaultsFactory& factory = defaults::DefaultsFactory::getInstance();
2675 const auto& defaults = factory.getDefaults();
2676 if (yarp::os::Time::now()-_last_position_move_time[j] < defaults.maxPositionMoveInterval)
2677 {
2678 yWarning() << getBoardInfo() << "Performance warning: You are using positionMove commands at high rate (<"<< defaults.maxPositionMoveInterval*1000.0 <<" ms). Probably position control mode is not the right control mode to use.";
2679 }
2680 _last_position_move_time[j] = yarp::os::Time::now();
2681
2682 yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum mode{};
2683 getControlModeRaw(j, mode);
2684 if( (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_POSITION) &&
2685 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_MIXED) &&
2686 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IMPEDANCE_POS) &&
2687 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IDLE))
2688 {
2689 if (_event_downsampler->canprint())
2690 {
2691 yError() << "positionMoveRaw: skipping command because " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << j << " is not in VOCAB_CM_POSITION mode";
2692 }
2693 return ReturnValue_ok;
2694 }
2695
2696 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_cmmnds_setpoint);
2697 _ref_command_positions[j] = ref; // save internally the new value of pos.
2698
2699 eOmc_setpoint_t setpoint;
2700
2701 setpoint.type = (eOenum08_t) eomc_setpoint_position;
2702 setpoint.to.position.value = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(_ref_command_positions[j]);
2703 setpoint.to.position.withvelocity = (eOmeas_velocity_t) S_32(_ref_speeds[j]);
2704
2705 return _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &setpoint) ? ReturnValue_ok : ReturnValue_error_generic;
2706}

2900ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::checkMotionDoneRaw(const std::vector<int>& joints, bool& flag)
2901{
2902
2903 //1) first of all, check if all joints number are ok
2904 for(int j=0; j<joints.size(); j++)
2905 {
2906 if((joints[j] >= _njoints) || (joints[j] < 0))
2907 {
2908 yError() << getBoardInfo() << ":checkMotionDoneRaw required for not existing joint ( " << joints[j] << ")";
2909 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2910 }
2911 }
2912
2913 //2) ask check motion done for all my joints
2914 std::vector <eObool_t> ismotiondoneList(_njoints);
2915 bool ret = askRemoteValues(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core_modes_ismotiondone, ismotiondoneList);
2916 if(false == ret)
2917 {
2918 yError () << getBoardInfo() << "Failure of askRemoteValues() inside embObjMotionControl::checkMotionDoneRaw for a group of joint"; getBoardInfo();
2919 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
2920 }
2921
2922 //3) verify only the given joints
2923 bool tot_val = true;
2924 for(int j=0; j<joints.size(); j++)
2925 {
2926 tot_val &= ismotiondoneList[joints[j]];
2927 }
2928
2929 flag = tot_val;
2930 return ReturnValue_ok;
2931
2932}

2999ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getAvailableControlModesRaw(int j, std::vector<yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum>& avail)
3000{
3001 avail.clear();
3002 if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trj[j].enabled)
3003 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_POSITION);
3004
3005 if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.mix[j].enabled)
3006 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_MIXED);
3007
3008 if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[j].enabled)
3009 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_POSITION_DIRECT);
3010
3011 if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[j].enabled)
3012 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY_DIRECT);
3013
3014
3015 if (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].enabled)
3016 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_TORQUE);
3017
3018 if( _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.cur[j].enabled)
3019 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_CURRENT);
3020
3021 if( _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.vel[j].enabled)
3022 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY);
3023
3024
3025 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IMPEDANCE_POS);
3026 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_PWM);
3027 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IDLE);
3028 avail.push_back(yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_FORCE_IDLE);
3029
3030 return ReturnValue_ok;
3031}

3075// marco.accame: con alberto cardellino abbiamo parlato della correttezza di effettuare la verifica di quanto imposto (in setControlModeRaw() ed affini)
3076// andando a rileggere il valore nella scheda eth fino a che esso non sia quello atteso. si deve fare oppure no?
3077// con il control mode il can ora lo fa ma e' giusto? era cosi' anche in passato?
3078ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setControlModeRaw(int j, yarp::dev::SelectableControlModeEnum _mode)
3079{
3080 bool ret = true;
3081 eOenum08_t controlmodecommand = 0;
3082 int modeInt = static_cast<int>(_mode);
3083
3084 if((modeInt == VOCAB_CM_TORQUE) && (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].enabled == false))
3085 {
3086 yError()<<"Torque control is disabled for joint "<< j <<"in " << getBoardInfo() << ". Check your configuration parameters ";
3087 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
3088 }
3089
3090 if((modeInt == VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY_DIRECT) && (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[j].enabled == false))
3091 {
3092 yError()<<"Velocity direct control is disabled for joint "<< j <<"in " << getBoardInfo() << ". Check your configuration parameters ";
3093 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
3094 }
3095
3096 if((modeInt == VOCAB_CM_POSITION_DIRECT) && (_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_pos[j].enabled == false))
3097 {
3098 yError()<<"Position direct control is disabled for joint "<< j <<"in " << getBoardInfo() << ". Check your configuration parameters ";
3099 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
3100 }
3101
3102 if(!controlModeCommandConvert_yarp2embObj(modeInt, controlmodecommand) )
3103 {
3104 yError() << "SetControlMode: received unknown control mode for " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << j << " mode " << Vocab32::decode(modeInt);
3105 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
3106 }
3107
3108 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_cmmnds_controlmode);
3109 if(false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &controlmodecommand) )
3110 {
3111 yError() << "setControlModeRaw failed for " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << j << " mode " << Vocab32::decode(modeInt);
3112 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
3113 }
3114
3115 if(!checkRemoteControlModeStatus(j, modeInt))
3116 {
3117 yError() << "In embObjMotionControl::setControlModeRaw(j=" << j << ", mode=" << yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(modeInt).c_str() << ") for " << getBoardInfo() << " has failed checkRemoteControlModeStatus()";
3118 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
3119 }
3120
3121 return ReturnValue_ok;
3122}

3473ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getAmpStatusRaw(int j, int *st)
3474{
3475 yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum mode{};
3476 if(!getControlModeRaw(j, mode))
3477 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
3478
3479 switch (static_cast<int>(mode))
3480 { case VOCAB_CM_IDLE:
3481 case VOCAB_CM_HW_FAULT:
3482 case VOCAB_CM_NOT_CONFIGURED:
3483 case VOCAB_CM_CONFIGURED:
3484 case VOCAB_CM_UNKNOWN:
3485 (*st) = 0; // disabled
3486 return ReturnValue_ok;
3487
3488 default:
3489 (*st) = 1; // disabled
3490 return ReturnValue_ok;
3491 };
3492
3493}

3519ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setPosLimitsRaw(int j, double min, double max)
3520{
3521 bool ret = true;
3522 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_userlimits);
3523
3524 eOmeas_position_limits_t limits;
3525 limits.max = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(max);
3526 limits.min = (eOmeas_position_t) S_32(min);
3527
3528 ret = _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &limits);
3529
3530
3531 if(!ret)
3532 {
3533 yError() << "while setting position limits for joint" << j << " \n";
3534 }
3535 return ReturnValue_ok;
3536}
3537
3538ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPosLimitsRaw(int j, double *min, double *max)
3539{
3540 eOmeas_position_limits_t limits;
3541 eOprotID32_t protoid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_userlimits);
3542 uint16_t size;
3543
3544 if(! askRemoteValue(protoid, &limits, size))
3545 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
3546
3547 defaults::DefaultsFactory& factory = defaults::DefaultsFactory::getInstance();
3548 const auto& defaults = factory.getDefaults();
3549 // TODO: is it correct to apply the delta to the limits read from the firmware?
3550 *min = (double)limits.min + defaults.jointPosLimitsDelta;
3551 *max = (double)limits.max - defaults.jointPosLimitsDelta;
3552 return ReturnValue_ok;
3553}

3569ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setGearboxRatioRaw(int j, const double val)

3571 eOprotID32_t protoid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_motor, j, eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config);

3590
3591 return ReturnValue_ok;

3827// IRemoteVariables
3828ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getRemoteVariableRaw(std::string key, yarp::os::Bottle& val)
3829{
3830 val.clear();
3831 if (key == "kinematic_mj")
3832 {
3833 // Return the reduced kinematic_mj matrix considering only the joints actually exposed to the user
3834 Bottle& ret = val.addList();
3835
3836 eOmn_serv_type_t mc_serv_type = (eOmn_serv_type_t)_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type;
3837 if(iNeedCouplingsInfo())
3838 {
3839 for (int r=0; r<_njoints; r++)
3840 {
3841 for (int c = 0; c < _njoints; c++)
3842 {
3843 // matrixJ2M is stored as row major in the eomc_couplingInfo_t,
3844 // and kinematic_mj is returned as a row major serialization as well
3845 ret.addFloat64(_parsedCfgData.couplingInfo.matrixJ2M[4 * r + c]);
3846 }
3847 }
3848 }
3849 else
3850 {
3851 ret.addFloat64(0.0);
3852 }
3853 return ReturnValue_ok;
3854 }
3855 else if (key == "encoders")
3856 {
3857 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i < _njoints; i++) { r.addFloat64(_measureConverter->posA2E(1.0, i)); }
3858 return ReturnValue_ok;
3859 }
3860 else if (key == "rotorEncoderResolution")
3861 {
3862 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i<_njoints; i++) { double tmp = 0; getRotorEncoderResolutionRaw(i, tmp); r.addFloat64(tmp); }
3863 return ReturnValue_ok;
3864 }
3865 else if (key == "jointEncoderResolution")
3866 {
3867 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i<_njoints; i++) { double tmp = 0; getJointEncoderResolutionRaw(i, tmp); r.addFloat64(tmp); }
3868 return ReturnValue_ok;
3869 }
3870 else if (key == "gearbox_M2J")
3871 {
3872 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i<_njoints; i++) { double tmp=0; getGearboxRatioRaw(i, &tmp); r.addFloat64(tmp); }
3873 return ReturnValue_ok;
3874 }
3875 else if (key == "gearbox_E2J")
3876 {
3877 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i<_njoints; i++) { double tmp=0; getGerabox_E2J(i, &tmp); r.addFloat64(tmp); }
3878 return ReturnValue_ok;
3879 }
3880 else if (key == "hasHallSensor")
3881 {
3882 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i < _njoints; i++) { int tmp = 0; getHasHallSensorRaw(i, tmp); r.addInt32(tmp); }
3883 return ReturnValue_ok;
3884 }
3885 else if (key == "hasTempSensor")
3886 {
3887 Bottle& r = val.addList(); for (int i = 0; i < _njoints; i++) { int tmp = 0; getHasTempSensorsRaw(i, tmp); r.addInt32(tmp); }
3888 return ReturnValue_ok;
3889 }

4266bool embObjMotionControl::updateVirtualAnalogSensorMeasure(int userLevel_jointNumber, double &fTorque)
4267{
4268 int j = _parsedCfgData.axisMap[userLevel_jointNumber];
4269
4270 eOmeas_torque_t meas_torque = 0;
4271 static double curr_time = Time::now();
4272 static int count_saturation=0;
4273
4274 meas_torque = (eOmeas_torque_t) S_32(_measureConverter->trqN2S(fTorque, j));
4275
4276 eOprotID32_t protoid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_inputs_externallymeasuredtorque);
4277// We don't need anymore to cache locally because ems board broadcast its torque value in joint status core
4278// // i write also locally because i want to read it back later on inside getTorqueRaw()
4279// _ethRes->setLocalValue(protoid, &meas_torque);
4280
4281 // and i want also to send it to the board
4282 return _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protoid, &meas_torque);
4283}

4353
4354ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getRefTorqueRaw(int j, double *t)
4355{
4356 eOprotID32_t id32 = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
4357 eOmc_joint_status_core_t jcore = {0};
4358 *t =0 ;
4359
4360
4361 if(!_ethRes->getLocalValue(id32, &jcore))
4362 {
4363 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::getRefTorqueRaw() could not read pid torque reference pos for " << getBoardInfo() << "joint " << j;
4364 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
4365 }
4366
4367 if ((eOmc_interactionmode_compliant == jcore.modes.interactionmodestatus) &&
4368 (eomc_controlmode_position == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus))
4369 {
4370 *t = (double) jcore.ofpid.complpos.reftrq;
4371 }
4372
4373 if(eomc_controlmode_torque == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus)
4374 {
4375 *t = (double) jcore.ofpid.torque.reftrq;
4376 }
4377
4378 return ReturnValue_ok;
4379}

4382{

4384

4386 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;

4392
4393bool embObjMotionControl::getWholeImpedanceRaw(int j, eOmc_impedance_t &imped)
4394{
4395 eOprotID32_t protoid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_impedance);
4396 uint16_t size;
4397 if(! askRemoteValue(protoid, &imped, size))
4398 return false;
4399
4400 // refresh cached value when reading data from the EMS
4401 _cacheImpedance[j].damping = imped.damping;
4402 _cacheImpedance[j].stiffness = imped.stiffness;
4403 _cacheImpedance[j].offset = imped.offset;
4404 return true;
4405}
4406
4407ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setImpedanceRaw(int j, double stiffness, double damping)
4408{
4409 bool ret = true;
4410 eOmc_impedance_t val;
4411
4412 // Need to read the whole struct and modify just 2 of them -> now aching the old values and re-using them.
4413 // first set is done in the open function because the whole joint config is sent to the EMSs
4414 // cleaner solution, split the impedance structure into 2 separeted nework variables
4415
4416 _cacheImpedance[j].stiffness = (eOmeas_stiffness_t) stiffness;
4417 _cacheImpedance[j].damping = (eOmeas_damping_t) damping;
4418
4419 val.stiffness = _cacheImpedance[j].stiffness;
4420 val.damping = _cacheImpedance[j].damping;
4421 val.offset = _cacheImpedance[j].offset;
4422
4423 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_impedance);
4424 ret &= _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &val);
4425
4426 return ret ? ReturnValue_ok : ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
4427}

4465ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getMotorTorqueParamsRaw(int j, MotorTorqueParameters *params)
4466{
4467 eOprotID32_t protoid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_motor_params);
4468
4469 uint16_t size;
4470 eOmc_motor_params_t eo_params = {0};
4471 if(! askRemoteValue(protoid, &eo_params, size))
4472 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
4473
4474 params->bemf = 0.0;
4475 params->bemf_scale = 0;
4476 params->ktau = eo_params.ktau_value;
4477 params->ktau_scale = eo_params.ktau_scale;
4478 params->viscousPos = eo_params.friction.viscous_pos_val;
4479 params->viscousNeg = eo_params.friction.viscous_neg_val ;
4480 params->coulombPos = eo_params.friction.coulomb_pos_val;
4481 params->coulombNeg = eo_params.friction.coulomb_neg_val;
4482 params->velocityThres = eo_params.friction.velocityThres_val;
4483
4484 //printf("debug getMotorTorqueParamsRaw %f %f %f %f %f %f %f %f\n", params->bemf, params->bemf_scale, params->ktau,params->ktau_scale, params->viscousPos, params->viscousNeg, params->coulombPos, params->coulombNeg, params->threshold);
4485
4486 return ReturnValue_ok;
4487}
4488
4489ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setMotorTorqueParamsRaw(int j, const MotorTorqueParameters params)
4490{
4491 if((params.bemf != 0.0) || (params.bemf_scale != 0))
4492 {
4493 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::setMotorTorqueParamsRaw() torque back-EMF parameters are not supported by this firmware protocol";
4494 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
4495 }
4496
4497 eOprotID32_t id32 = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_config_motor_params);
4498 eOmc_motor_params_t eo_params = {0};
4499
4500 //printf("setMotorTorqueParamsRaw for j %d(INPUT): benf=%f ktau=%f viscousPos=%f viscousNeg=%f coulombPos=%f coulombNeg=%f\n",j, params.bemf, params.ktau, params.viscousPos, params.viscousNeg, params.coulombPos, params.coulombNeg, params.threshold);
4501
4502 eo_params.bemf_scale = 0;
4503 eo_params.ktau_value = (float) params.ktau;
4504 eo_params.ktau_scale = (uint8_t) params.ktau_scale;
4505 eo_params.friction.viscous_pos_val = static_cast<float32_t>(params.viscousPos);
4506 eo_params.friction.viscous_neg_val = static_cast<float32_t>(params.viscousNeg);
4507 eo_params.friction.coulomb_pos_val = static_cast<float32_t>(params.coulombPos);
4508 eo_params.friction.coulomb_neg_val = static_cast<float32_t>(params.coulombNeg);
4509 eo_params.friction.velocityThres_val = static_cast<float32_t>(params.velocityThres);
4510
4511 //save these values in the trqPid structure because the motor torque parameters are used inside the torque PID controller in the parser so they are alway consisten
4512 _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].viscousPos = params.viscousPos;
4513 _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].viscousNeg = params.viscousNeg;
4514 _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].coulombPos = params.coulombPos;
4515 _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].coulombNeg = params.coulombNeg;
4516 _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.trq[j].velocityThres = params.velocityThres;
4517
4518 if(false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(id32, &eo_params))
4519 {
4520 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::setMotorTorqueParamsRaw() could not send set message for" << getBoardInfo() << "joint " << j;
4521 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
4522 }
4523
4524 return ReturnValue_ok;
4525}

4750ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getInteractionModeRaw(int j, yarp::dev::InteractionModeEnum & _mode)
4751{
4752 eOenum08_t interactionmodestatus;
4753// std::cout << "eoMC getInteractionModeRaw SINGLE joint " << j << std::endl;

4871
4872ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidOutputRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, int j, double *out)
4873{
4874 *out = 0;
4875 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
4876 {
4877 return ReturnValue_ok;
4878 }
4879
4880 eOprotID32_t protoId = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, j, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core);
4881 eOmc_joint_status_core_t jcore = {0};
4882 if(!_ethRes->getLocalValue(protoId, &jcore) )
4883 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
4884
4885 switch (pidtype)
4886 {
4887 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION:
4888 if((eomc_controlmode_torque == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) || (eomc_controlmode_current == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus))
4889 *out=0;
4890 else
4891 *out = (double) jcore.ofpid.generic.output;
4892 break;
4893 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_POSITION_DIRECT:
4894 *out=0;
4895 break;
4896 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_TORQUE:
4897 if ((eomc_controlmode_torque == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) ||
4898 ((eomc_controlmode_position == jcore.modes.controlmodestatus) && (eOmc_interactionmode_compliant == jcore.modes.interactionmodestatus)))
4899 *out = jcore.ofpid.generic.output;
4900 else
4901 *out = 0;
4902 break;
4903 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_CURRENT:
4904 *out = jcore.ofpid.generic.output;
4905 break;
4906 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY:
4907 *out = jcore.ofpid.generic.output;
4908 break;
4909 case PidControlTypeEnum::VOCAB_PIDTYPE_VELOCITY_DIRECT:
4910 *out = jcore.ofpid.generic.output;
4911 break;
4912 default:
4913 const auto pidtypeVocab = static_cast<yarp::conf::vocab32_t>(pidtype);
4914 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "Invalid pidtype:"<< yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(pidtypeVocab) << "in "<< __YFUNCTION__;
4915 break;
4916 }
4917 return ReturnValue_ok;
4918}
4919
4920ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getPidOutputsRaw(const PidControlTypeEnum& pidtype, double *outs)
4921{
4922 if (isUnsupportedPidAlias(pidtype))
4923 {
4924 std::fill_n(outs, _njoints, 0.0);
4925 return ReturnValue_ok;
4926 }
4927
4928 ReturnValue ret = ReturnValue_ok;
4929 for(int j=0; j< _njoints; j++)
4930 {
4931 ret &= getPidOutputRaw(pidtype, j, &outs[j]);
4932 }
4933 return ret;

4943{

4946

4948 if (_parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(m)->getType() == motor_temperature_sensor_none)
4949 return ReturnValue_ok;
4950
4951
4952 bool ret = _ethRes->getLocalValue(protid, &status);

4954 {

4957 }
4958
4959 *val = _parsedCfgData.temperatureSensorsVector.at(m)->convertRawToTempCelsius((double)status.mot_temperature);
4960
4961
4962 return ret ? ReturnValue_ok : ReturnValue_error_generic;

5150template <class T>
5151bool embObjMotionControl::askRemoteValues(eOprotEndpoint_t ep, eOprotEntity_t entity, eOprotTag_t tag, std::vector<T>& values)
5152{
5153 std::vector<eOprotID32_t> idList;
5154 std::vector<void*> valueList;
5155 idList.clear();
5156 valueList.clear();
5157 for(int j=0; j<_njoints; j++)
5158 {
5159 eOprotID32_t protoId = eoprot_ID_get(ep, entity, j, tag);
5160 idList.push_back(protoId);
5161 valueList.push_back((void*)&values[j]);
5162 }
5163
5164 bool ret = _ethRes->getRemoteValues(idList, valueList);
5165 if(!ret)
5166 {
5167 yError() << "embObjMotionControl::askRemoteValues failed for all joints of" << getBoardInfo();
5168 }
5169
5170 return ret;
5171}
5172
5173bool embObjMotionControl::checkRemoteControlModeStatus(int joint, int target_mode)
5174{
5175 bool ret = false;
5176 eOenum08_t temp = 0;
5177 uint16_t size = 0;
5178
5179 eOprotID32_t id32 = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, joint, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_status_core_modes_controlmodestatus);
5180 const double timeout = 0.250; // 250 msec
5181 const int maxretries = 25;
5182 const double delaybetweenqueries = 0.010; // 10 msec
5183
5184 // now i repeat the query until i am satisfied. how many times? for maximum time timeout seconds and with a gap of delaybetweenqueries
5185
5186 double timeofstart = yarp::os::Time::now();
5187 int attempt = 0;
5188
5189 for( attempt = 0; attempt < maxretries; attempt++)
5190 {
5191 ret = askRemoteValue(id32, &temp, size);
5192 if(ret == false)
5193 {
5194 yError ("An error occurred inside embObjMotionControl::checkRemoteControlModeStatus(j=%d, targetmode=%s) for BOARD %s IP %s", joint, yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(target_mode).c_str(), _ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString.c_str(), _ethRes->getProperties().ipv4addrString.c_str());
5195 break;
5196 }
5197 int current_mode = controlModeStatusConvert_embObj2yarp(temp);
5198 if(current_mode == target_mode)
5199 {
5200 ret = true;
5201 break;
5202 }
5203 if((current_mode == VOCAB_CM_IDLE) && (target_mode == VOCAB_CM_FORCE_IDLE))
5204 {
5205 ret = true;
5206 break;
5207 }
5208 if(current_mode == VOCAB_CM_HW_FAULT)
5209 {
5210 if(target_mode != VOCAB_CM_FORCE_IDLE) { yError ("embObjMotionControl::checkRemoteControlModeStatus(%d, %d) is unable to check the control mode of BOARD %s IP %s because it is now in HW_FAULT", joint, target_mode, _ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString.c_str(), _ethRes->getProperties().ipv4addrString.c_str()); }
5211 ret = true;
5212 break;
5213 }
5214
5215 if((yarp::os::Time::now()-timeofstart) > timeout)
5216 {
5217 ret = false;
5218 yError ("A %f sec timeout occured in embObjMotionControl::checkRemoteControlModeStatus(), BOARD %s IP %s, joint %d, current mode: %s, requested: %s", timeout, _ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString.c_str(), _ethRes->getProperties().ipv4addrString.c_str(), joint, yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(current_mode).c_str(), yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(target_mode).c_str());
5219 break;
5220 }
5221 if(attempt > 0)
5222 { // i print the warning only after at least one retry.
5223 yWarning ("embObjMotionControl::checkRemoteControlModeStatus() has done %d attempts and will retry again after a %f sec delay. (BOARD %s IP %s, joint %d) -> current mode = %s, requested = %s", attempt+1, delaybetweenqueries, _ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString.c_str() , _ethRes->getProperties().ipv4addrString.c_str(), joint, yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(current_mode).c_str(), yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(target_mode).c_str());
5224 }
5225 SystemClock::delaySystem(delaybetweenqueries);
5226 }
5227
5228 if(false == ret)
5229 {
5230 yError("failure of embObjMotionControl::checkRemoteControlModeStatus(j=%d, targetmode=%s) for BOARD %s IP %s after %d attempts and %f seconds", joint, yarp::os::Vocab32::decode(target_mode).c_str(), _ethRes->getProperties().boardnameString.c_str(), _ethRes->getProperties().ipv4addrString.c_str(), attempt, yarp::os::Time::now()-timeofstart);
5231 }
5232
5233
5234 return ret;
5235}

5237//the device needs coupling info if it manages joints controlled by 2foc and mc4plus.
5238bool embObjMotionControl::iNeedCouplingsInfo(void)
5239{
5240 eOmn_serv_type_t mc_serv_type = (eOmn_serv_type_t)_parsedCfgData.serviceConfig.ethservice.configuration.type;
5241 if( (mc_serv_type == eomn_serv_MC_foc) ||
5242 (mc_serv_type == eomn_serv_MC_mc4plus) ||
5243 (mc_serv_type == eomn_serv_MC_mc4plusmais) ||
5244 (mc_serv_type == eomn_serv_MC_mc2pluspsc) ||
5245 (mc_serv_type == eomn_serv_MC_mc4plusfaps) ||
5246 (mc_serv_type == eomn_serv_MC_advfoc)
5247 )
5248 return true;
5249 else
5250 return false;
5251}

5429ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::helper_setVelDirPidRaw(int j, const Pid &pid)
5430{
5431 eOprotID32_t protoId;
5432 eOmc_PID_t outPid;
5433 Pid hwPid = pid;
5434
5435 if (!_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[j].enabled)
5436 {
5437 yError() << "eoMc " << getBoardInfo() << ": it is not possible set direct velocity pid for motor " << j << ", because current pid is not enabled in xml files";
5438 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
5439 }
5440
5441 if( _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[j].out_type == eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_pwm )
5442 {
5443 protoId = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_motor, j, eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config_pidvelpwm);
5444 }
5445 else if( _parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[j].out_type == eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_cur )
5446 {
5447 protoId = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_motor, j, eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config_pidvelcur);
5448 }
5449 else
5450 { yError() << "eoMc " << getBoardInfo() << __YFUNCTION__ << " for motor " << j ;
5451 return ReturnValue_error_generic;
5452 }
5453
5454 copyPid_iCub2eo(&hwPid, &outPid);
5455
5456 if (false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protoId, &outPid))
5457 {
5458 yError() << getBoardInfo() << __YFUNCTION__ << "while asking remote value for" << " joint " << j;
5459 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
5460 }
5461
5462 return ReturnValue_ok;
5463}
5464
5465ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::helper_getVelDirPidRaw(int j, Pid *pid)
5466{
5467 eOprotID32_t protoid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_motor, j, eoprot_tag_mc_motor_config);
5468 uint16_t size;
5469 eOmc_motor_config_t motor_cfg;
5470 if (!askRemoteValue(protoid, &motor_cfg, size))
5471 {
5472 yError() << getBoardInfo() << __YFUNCTION__ << "error in asking velocity direct pid for joint" << j ;
5473 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
5474 }
5475
5476 eOmc_PID_t tmp;
5477 switch(_parsedCfgData.pidControllers.dir_vel[j].out_type)
5478 {
5479 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_pwm:
5480 tmp = (eOmc_PID_t)motor_cfg.pidvelpwm;
5481 break;
5482 case eomc_ctrl_out_type_vel_cur:
5483 tmp = (eOmc_PID_t)motor_cfg.pidvelcur;
5484 break;
5485 default:
5486 yError() << getBoardInfo() << __YFUNCTION__ << "Invalid output type for velocity direct pid for joint " << j;
5487 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
5488 }
5489 copyPid_eo2iCub(&tmp, pid);
5490
5491 return ReturnValue_ok;
5492}

5586ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::getLastJointFaultRaw(int j, int& fault, std::string& message)
5587{
5588 eOmc_motor_status_t status;
5589
5590 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol,
5591 eoprot_entity_mc_motor, j,
5592 eoprot_tag_mc_motor_status);
5593
5594 bool ret = _ethRes->getLocalValue(protid, &status);
5595
5596 message.clear();
5597
5598 if (!ret)
5599 {
5600 fault = -1;
5601 message = "Could not retrieve the fault state.";
5602 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
5603 }
5604
5605 if (status.mc_fault_state == EOERROR_CODE_DUMMY)
5606 {
5607 fault = EOERROR_CODE_DUMMY;
5608 message = "No fault detected.";
5609
5610 return ReturnValue_ok;
5611 }
5612
5613 fault = eoerror_code2value(status.mc_fault_state);
5614 message = eoerror_code2string(status.mc_fault_state);
5615
5616 return ReturnValue_ok;
5617}

5619bool embObjMotionControl::getRawData_core(std::string key, std::vector<std::int32_t> &data)
5620{
5621 // Here I need to be sure 100% the key exists!!!

5624 for(int j=0; j< _njoints; j++)

5632 for (int k = 0; k < std::size(addinfo.multienc); k++)

5635 }
5636
5637 }
5638 return true;
5639}

5734ReturnValue embObjMotionControl::setRefVelocityRaw(int jnt, double vel)
5735{
5736 yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum mode{};
5737 getControlModeRaw(jnt, mode);
5738 if( (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY_DIRECT) &&
5739 (mode != yarp::dev::ControlModeEnum::VOCAB_CM_IDLE)) //TODO: remove VOCAB_CM_IDLE exception when eoMc boards will properly support switching to VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY_DIRECT from other control modes different from VOCAB_CM_IDLE
5740 {
5741 if(_event_downsampler->canprint())
5742 {
5743 yError() << "setRefVelocityRaw: skipping command because " << getBoardInfo() << " joint " << jnt << " is not in VOCAB_CM_VELOCITY_DIRECT mode";
5744 }
5745 return ReturnValue_ok;
5746 }
5747
5748 eOmc_setpoint_t setpoint;
5749 setpoint.type = eomc_setpoint_velocityraw;
5750
5751 setpoint.to.velocityraw.value = (eOmeas_velocity_t) S_32(vel);
5752
5753 eOprotID32_t protid = eoprot_ID_get(eoprot_endpoint_motioncontrol, eoprot_entity_mc_joint, jnt, eoprot_tag_mc_joint_cmmnds_setpoint);
5754
5755 if(false == _ethRes->setRemoteValue(protid, &setpoint))
5756 {
5757 yError() << getBoardInfo() << "while setting velocity direct target for" << "joint " << jnt;
5758 return ReturnValue_error_method_failed;
5759 }
5760
5761 return ReturnValue_ok;
5762}
